fields.title: Omuzabbibu ogw’Amazima
fields.subtitle: Okufumiitiriza okw’Omwezi Mulamba ku Yokaana 15
fields.description: Emisomo amakumi asatu mu gumu egya Andrew Murray egy’okufumiitiriza ku muzabbibu n’amatabi — omwezi mulamba mu ssuula ey’ekkumi n’ettaano eya Yokaana. Buli lunaku akkaatiriza ekyama kimu eky’obulamu obubala ebibala: okubeera mu Kristo. Okuva ku Muzabbibu n’Omulimi, ng’ayita mu kambe akasalira, mu “temuliiko kye muyinza kukola,” ne mu kwagala okw’ekitalo, okutuuka ku kusaba okuwangula, kino kye kikoowoola kya Murray ekisinga obukkakkamu era ekisinga okussa essira ku kubeera mu Kristo.

qa.question: Ekitabo “Omuzabbibu ogw’Amazima” kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kitabo kya Andrew Murray ekirimu emisomo amakumi asatu mu gumu emimpi egy’okufumiitiriza buli lunaku ku muzabbibu n’amatabi — omwezi mulamba mu ssuula ey’ekkumi n’ettaano eya Yokaana. Buli lunaku Murray akkaatiriza ekyama kimu eky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo obubala ebibala: okubeera mu Kristo. Okuva ku Muzabbibu n’Omulimi, ng’ayita mu kulongoosa ne mu bibala, annyonnyola kye kitegeeza okusigala mu Kristo n’okuleka obulamu bwe okukulukutira mu ffe.

qa.question: Lwaki Murray yakitegeka ng’emisomo egya buli lunaku?
qa.answer: Kubanga okubeera mu Kristo kuyigibwa mu kukomawo ku kyo emirundi n’emirundi, so si mu kukitegeera omulundi gumu. Murray awa essuula amakumi asatu mu emu empimpi, emu ku buli lunaku lw’omwezi, nga buli emu etwala ekigambo kimu okuva mu Yokaana 15, omusomi alyoke afumiitirize ku mazima ago gamu buli nkya, okutuusa okubeera mu Kristo lwe kutaba kirowoozo bulowooza, wabula empisa y’omutima ennywevu.

qa.question: ‘Okubeera mu Kristo’ kitegeeza ki mu kitabo kino?
qa.answer: Kitegeeza okusigala nga weegasse ne Kristo mu bulamu, ng’ettabi bwe lisigala ku muzabbibu — ng’oggya obulamu bwonna, amaanyi n’ebibala mu Ye, so si mu ggwe wennyini. Murray ayigiriza nti omulimu gw’ettabi gwonna gwe kusigala nga liyungiddwa ku muzabbibu n’okuleka amazzi g’obulamu gaagwo okulikulukutiramu; ebibala bikolebwa muzabbibu, so si kufuba kw’ettabi. Okubeera mu Kristo kwe kumwesigama, okuba omwetegefu okufuna okuva gy’ali, n’okuwummulira mu Ye.

qa.question: Murray agamba ki ku ttabi okubala ebibala?
qa.answer: Nti ebibala bye biva mu kubeera mu Kristo mu ngeri ey’obutonde era enkakafu, so si kye bakaka ettabi okuleeta mu maanyi. Ettabi eriyungiddwa ku muzabbibu omulamu teriyinza butabala bibala; bwe kityo n’omukkiriza abeera mu Kristo ddala alibala ebibala by’obulamu obufaanana obwa Kristo. Murray aggya omusomi ku kufuba okw’okweraliikirira, n’amukyusa eri akakwakkulizo kamu Kristo ke yawa — mubeere mu Nze — n’aleka ebibala okugoberera.

qa.question: Murray annyonnyola atya okulongoosa okwogerwako mu Yokaana 15?
qa.answer: Atwala nga kikulu nnyo ekigambo kya Yesu nti Kitaffe alongoosa n’ettabi eribala, lyongere okubala ebibala ebingi. Murray alaba ebigezo n’ebifiirwa eby’omu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo ng’akambe akasalira ak’Omulimi — si kibonerezo wabula okulabirira, okusalako ekiziyiza okukula. Ayigiriza nti okulongoosa kabonero k’okwagala kwa Kitaffe eri ettabi ly’ayagala libale ebibala ebingi okusingawo, so si ebitono.

qa.question: Andrew Murray yali ani?
qa.answer: Yali musumba ow’e Afirika ey’Obukiikaddyo era omu ku bawandiisi abaagalwa ennyo ab’ebitabo by’okufumiitiriza ku bulamu bw’Omukristaayo obw’omunda obw’ebuziba, eyawandiika ebitabo bingi ebimpi ku kusaba n’okubeera mu Kristo, nga mw’otwalidde “Abide in Christ” ne “Obwetoowaze”. “Omuzabbibu ogw’Amazima”, ekyafulumizibwa mu 1897, kiri mu kika kye kimu ekyo — okufumiitiriza okw’omwezi mulamba ku kwegatta ne Kristo, okwali omutima gw’okuyigiriza kwe.

qa.question: Ani ayinza okuganyulwa mu kitabo kino?
qa.answer: Omukristaayo yenna akooye okufuba mu maanyi ge yennyini, oba ayagala ennyo okutambula ne Katonda mu ngeri ebala ebibala ebisingawo era erimu ekiwummulo. Murray awandiikira omukkiriza owa bulijjo, era okukkaatiriza kwe okw’obukkakkamu okuddiŋŋanwa ku ssomo eryo limu — beera mu Kristo — kufudde ekitabo kino obuyambi obw’olubeerera eri abo abanoonya okuba abalamu nga Kristo ye nsibuko yaabwe, so si okumukolera mu maanyi gaabwe.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanidde kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku musomo gw’olunaku olusooka, oluvannyuma omusomo gumu buli lunaku okumala omwezi, awatali kwanguyiriza. Ekitabo kyategekebwa okusomebwa mpola, mu kusaba, so si okukimalira omulundi gumu; bw’okisoma olunaku ku lunaku, okufumiitiriza kwakyo ku muzabbibu n’amatabi kukka mpolampola mu mutima okutuusa okubeera mu Kristo lwe kufuuka engeri y’omusomi ey’obulamu ennywevu.

fields.title: Ebigambo eby’Okusooka
fields.body_html:
Mpulidde nga nsikirizibwa okugezaako okuwandiika ekyo Abakristaayo abato kye bayinza okutegeera amangu, okubayamba okutuuka mu kifo ekyo obulamu bw’Omukristaayo mwe bulina okugendera obulungi. Kiri ng’olinga tewali kikemo kikulu wadde okulemererwa okw’amaanyi mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo ebitaddibwamu wano. Okubeera kumpi kwa Mukama Yesu, obumala bwe mu byonna, obwesigwa bwe, n’engeri obulamu obw’okukkiriza gye bubeera obw’obutonde era obubala ebibala, byonna bibikkuliddwa bulungi nnyo, ne kiba ng’omuntu ayinza okugamba n’obuvumu nti, Olugero luno luyingire mu mutima, byonna bijja kutereera.

Mukama waffe omutendereze awe omukisa. Atuyigirize okwekenneenya ekyama ky’Omuzabbibu mu mwoyo ogw’okusinza, nga tulindirira okuyigirizibwa Katonda yennyini.

fields.title: Omuzabbibu (Yokaana 15:1)
fields.body_html:
Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima—Yokaana 15:1

Ebintu byonna eby’oku nsi bisiikirize by’ebintu ebya ddala eby’omu ggulu—bye biraga, mu bifaananyi ebitondeddwa era ebirabika, ekitiibwa kya Katonda ekitalabika. Obulamu n’Amazima biri mu ggulu; ku nsi tulina ebifaananyi n’ebisiikirize by’amazima ag’omu ggulu. Yesu bw’agamba nti: “Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima,” aba atutegeeza nti emizabbibu gyonna egy’oku nsi bifaananyi era bubonero bwe ye yennyini. Ye ye kintu kya ddala ekya Katonda, gyo nga kye kifaananyi kye ekitondeddwa. Gyonna gimusongako, gimubuulira, era gimubikkula. Bw’oba oyagala okumanya Yesu, yekkaanya omuzabbibu.

Amaaso mangi nnyo gatunuulidde omuzabbibu omunene n’ebibala byagwo ebirungi ne gaguwuunya. Jjangu otunuulire Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu okutuusa eriiso lyo lwe linaava ku birala byonna ne limwewuunya Ye. Bangi nnyo, mu nsi ey’omusana, abatuula ne bawummulira mu kisiikirize ky’omuzabbibu. Jjangu osirikire wansi w’ekisiikirize ky’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, owummulire wansi waakyo ng’owona ebbugumu ly’emisana. Bantu bangi nnyo abasanyukira ebibala by’omuzabbibu! Jjangu, otwale, olye ku bibala eby’omu ggulu eby’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, emmeeme yo egambe nti: “Neesiima okutuula mu kisiikirize kye, n’ekibala kye kimpomera.”

Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima.—Kino kyama kya mu ggulu. Omuzabbibu ogw’oku nsi guyinza okukuyigiriza bingi ku Muzabbibu guno ogw’omu ggulu. Ebifaananyi bingi ebisanyusa era ebirungi bijja mu birowoozo, ne bituyamba okutegeera Kristo kye yali ategeeza. Naye ebirowoozo ng’ebyo tebituyigiriza kumanya Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu bwe guli ddala, mu kisiikirize kyagwo ekiweweeza, ne mu bibala byagwo ebiwa obulamu. Okukimanya mu bulamu bw’omuntu kitundu ku kyama ekikusike, ekitayinza kubikkulwa na kugabibwa wabula Yesu yennyini, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we Omutukuvu.

Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima.—Omuzabbibu ye Mukama omulamu, ayogera yennyini, era agaba era akola byonna by’atulinako. Bw’oba oyagala okutegeera amakulu n’amaanyi g’ekigambo ekyo, tosuubira kukifuna mu kulowooza oba mu kusoma; ebyo biyinza okukuyamba okulaba ky’olina okufuna okuva gy’ali okuzuukusa okwegomba, essuubi n’okusaba, naye tebiyinza kukulaga Muzabbibu. Yesu yekka y’ayinza okwebikkula. Awa Omwoyo we Omutukuvu okuzibula amaaso gamutunuulire, n’okuggula omutima gumusembeze. Ye yennyini y’alina okwogera ekigambo ekyo gy’oli ne gye ndi.

Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima.—Kale nkole ki, bwe njagala ekyama kino kinzigulirwe mu bulungi bwakyo bwonna obw’omu ggulu ne mu mukisa gwakyo? Ng’oli n’ebyo by’omanyi edda ku lugero luno, kutama osirike, sinza olindirire, okutuusa Ekigambo kya Katonda lwe kinaayingira mu mutima gwo, n’owulira ng’ali naawe era ng’ali mu ggwe mu butukuvu bwe. Ekisiikirize ky’okwagala kwe okutukuvu kinaakuwa emirembe egituukiridde n’ekiwummulo eky’okumanya nti Omuzabbibu gwe gunaakola byonna.

Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima.—Oyo ayogera ye Katonda, ayinza mu buyinza bwe obutaliiko kkomo okuyingira mu ffe. Ye muntu, omu naffe. Ye Oyo eyakomererwa, eyatufunira obutuukirivu obutuukiridde n’obulamu obw’obwakatonda olw’okufa kwe. Ye Oyo eyagulumizibwa, agaba Omwoyo we ng’asinziira ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka, okufuula okubeerawo kwe okwa ddala era okw’amazima. Ayogera—oh, wuliriza, si bigambo bye byokka, wabula Ye yennyini, ng’akwogerera mu kaama buli lunaku: “Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima! Byonna omuzabbibu bye guyinza okubeera eri ettabi lyagwo, “bye ndibeera gy’oli.”

Mukama Yesu Omutukuvu, Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu Katonda gwe yeesimbira yennyini, nkwegayiridde, weebikkulire emmeeme yange. Omwoyo Omutukuvu, si mu birowoozo byokka naye ne mu bulamu bwange, ammanyise byonna by’oli gye ndi, ggwe Omwana wa Katonda, ng’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima.

fields.title: Omulimi
fields.body_html:
Ate Kitange ye mulimi—Yokaana 15:1

Omuzabbibu gwetaaga omulimi okugusimba n’okugulabirira, okukungula ebibala byagwo n’okubisanyukira. Yesu agamba nti: “Kitange ye mulimi.” Ye yali “omuzabbibu Katonda gwe yasimba.” Byonna bye yali ne bye yakola yabiweebwa Kitaffe; mu byonna yanoonya kwagala kwa Kitaffe n’ekitiibwa kye kyokka. Yali afuuse omuntu atulage ekitonde kye kisaanidde okubeera eri Omutonzi waakyo. Yatwala ekifo kyaffe, era omwoyo gw’obulamu bwe mu maaso ga Kitaffe bulijjo gwali ogwo gw’ayagala okufuula ogwaffe: “byonna biva gy’ali, era biyita mu ye era bidda gy’ali.” Yafuuka Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, ffe tulyoke tubeere amatabi ag’amazima. Ku Kristo ne ku ffe, ebigambo bino bituyigiriza ebintu bibiri: okwesigama ku Katonda mu byonna, n’okumwesiga okutuukiridde.

Kitange ye mulimi.—Kristo bulijjo yabeeranga mu mwoyo gw’ekyo kye yagamba lumu nti: “Omwana taliiko ky’akola ku bubwe.” Ng’omuzabbibu bwe gwesigama ku mulimi olw’ekifo mwe gulina okukulira, olw’okugukomera, okugufukirira n’okugusalira. Kristo yawulira nga yeesigamye ddala ku Kitaffe buli lunaku okufuna amagezi n’amaanyi okukola Kitaffe by’ayagala. Nga bwe yagamba mu ssuula eyasooka (14:10): “Ebigambo bye mbategeeza si byange ku bwange, wabula biva eri Kitange abeera mu Nze, era akola emirimu ng’ayita mu Nze.” Okwesigama kuno okujjuvu kwalina ku ludda lwakwo olulala obwesige obw’omukisa ennyo nti teyalina ky’atya: Kitaffe teyayinza kumulekerera. Ng’alina Kitaffe ng’Omulimi we, yayinza okuyingira mu kufa ne mu ntaana. Yayinza okwesiga Katonda okumuzuukiza. Byonna Kristo by’ali ne by’alina, abirina si mu ye yennyini, wabula okuva eri Kitaffe.

Kitange ye mulimi.—Ekyo kya mazima ag’omukisa gye tuli nga bwe kiri eri Kristo. Kristo anaatera okuyigiriza abayigirizwa be nti bo matabi. Nga tannaba na kukozesa kigambo ekyo, oba okwogera n’akatono ku kubeera mu Ye oba ku kubala ebibala, akyusa amaaso gaabwe ne gatunula waggulu eri Kitaffe abalabirira era akola byonna mu bo. Ku kikolo ddala eky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo bwonna kwe kuli ekirowoozo nti Katonda y’alina okukola byonna, nti omulimu gwaffe kwe kwewaayo ne twerekera mu mikono gye, nga twatula nti tetuliiko kye tusobola era nti twesigamye ku ye, era nga tukakasa nti atuwa byonna bye twetaaga. Ekibulamu ekinene mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo kwe kuba nti, ne bwe twesiga Kristo, Katonda tumuleka bweru. Kristo yajja okututuusa eri Katonda. Kristo yawangaala obulamu bw’omuntu ddala nga ffe bwe tulina okubuwangaala. Kristo Omuzabbibu asonga ku Katonda Omulimi. Nga bwe yeesiga Katonda, naffe twesige Katonda nti byonna bye tusaanidde okubeera ne bye tusaanidde okuba nabyo, ng’abo abali ku Muzabbibu, tulibiweebwa okuva waggulu.

Isaaya yagamba nti: “ennimiro ey’emizabbibu ebaze ebibala; Nze Mukama Katonda, ennimiro nze ngirabirira era nze ngifukirira buli kiseera. Ngikuuma emisana n’ekiro Waleme kubaawo n’omu agikola akabi.” Nga tetunnatandika kulowooza ku bibala oba ku matabi, emitima gyaffe gijjule okukkiriza kuno: nga Omuzabbibu bwe gulina ekitiibwa, n’Omulimi bw’atyo. Okuyitibwa kwaffe nga bwe kuli okw’awaggulu era okutukuvu, bw’atyo Katonda alikutuukiriza kwonna bw’ali ow’amaanyi era ow’okwagala. Nga Omulimi bwe yafuula Omuzabbibu ekyo kye gwalina okubeera, bw’atyo bw’alifuula buli ttabi ekyo kye lirina okubeera. Kitaffe ye Mulimi waffe, Omweyimirizi w’okukula kwaffe n’ebibala byaffe.

Kitaffe Omutendereze, tuli nnimiro yo. Oh, ofune ekitiibwa olw’omulimu gw’emikono gyo! Ai Kitange, njagala okuggulira omutima gwange essanyu ly’amazima gano ag’ekitalo: Kitange ye Mulimi. Njigiriza okukumanya n’okukwesiga, n’okulaba nti okufaayo okwo okw’omunda kwe walabiriramu Omuzabbibu era kwe wagusanyukiramu, kutuuka ku buli ttabi, ne ku nze.

Kristo yawulira nga yeesigamye ddala ku Kitaffe buli lunaku okufuna amagezi n’amaanyi okukola Kitaffe by’ayagala. Nga bwe yagamba mu ssuula eyasooka (14:10): “Ebigambo bye mbategeeza si byange ku bwange, wabula biva eri Kitange abeera mu Nze, era akola emirimu ng’ayita mu Nze.” Okwesigama kuno okujjuvu kwalina ku ludda lwakwo olulala obwesige obw’omukisa ennyo nti teyalina ky’atya: Kitaffe teyayinza kumulekerera. Ng’alina Kitaffe ng’Omulimi we, yayinza okuyingira mu kufa ne mu ntaana. Yayinza okwesiga Katonda okumuzuukiza. Byonna Kristo by’ali ne by’alina, abirina si mu ye yennyini, wabula okuva eri Kitaffe. Kitange ye mulimi.—Ekyo kya mazima ag’omukisa gye tuli nga bwe kiri eri Kristo. Kristo anaatera okuyigiriza abayigirizwa be nti bo matabi. Nga tannaba na kukozesa kigambo ekyo, oba okwogera n’akatono ku kubeera mu Ye oba ku kubala ebibala, akyusa amaaso gaabwe ne gatunula waggulu eri Kitaffe abalabirira era akola byonna mu bo. Ku kikolo ddala eky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo bwonna kwe kuli ekirowoozo nti Katonda y’alina okukola byonna, nti omulimu gwaffe kwe kwewaayo ne twerekera mu mikono gye, nga twatula nti tetuliiko kye tusobola era nti twesigamye ku ye, era nga tukakasa nti atuwa byonna bye twetaaga. Ekibulamu ekinene mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo kwe kuba nti, ne bwe twesiga Kristo, Katonda tumuleka bweru. Kristo yajja okututuusa eri Katonda. Kristo yawangaala obulamu bw’omuntu ddala nga ffe bwe tulina okubuwangaala. Kristo Omuzabbibu asonga ku Katonda Omulimi. Nga bwe yeesiga Katonda, naffe twesige Katonda nti byonna bye tusaanidde okubeera ne bye tusaanidde okuba nabyo, ng’abo abali ku Muzabbibu, tulibiweebwa okuva waggulu. Isaaya yagamba nti: “ennimiro ey’emizabbibu ebaze ebibala; Nze Mukama Katonda, ennimiro nze ngirabirira era nze ngifukirira buli kiseera. Ngikuuma emisana n’ekiro Waleme kubaawo n’omu agikola akabi.” Nga tetunnatandika kulowooza ku bibala oba ku matabi, emitima gyaffe gijjule okukkiriza kuno: nga Omuzabbibu bwe gulina ekitiibwa, n’Omulimi bw’atyo. Okuyitibwa kwaffe nga bwe kuli okw’awaggulu era okutukuvu, bw’atyo Katonda alikutuukiriza kwonna bw’ali ow’amaanyi era ow’okwagala. Nga Omulimi bwe yafuula Omuzabbibu ekyo kye gwalina okubeera, bw’atyo bw’alifuula buli ttabi ekyo kye lirina okubeera. Kitaffe ye Mulimi waffe, Omweyimirizi w’okukula kwaffe n’ebibala byaffe. Kitaffe Omutendereze, tuli nnimiro yo. Oh, ofune ekitiibwa olw’omulimu gw’emikono gyo! Ai Kitange, njagala okuggulira omutima gwange essanyu ly’amazima gano ag’ekitalo: Kitange ye Mulimi. Njigiriza okukumanya n’okukwesiga, n’okulaba nti okufaayo okwo okw’omunda kwe walabiriramu Omuzabbibu era kwe wagusanyukiramu, kutuuka ku buli ttabi, ne ku nze.

fields.title: Ettabi
fields.body_html:
Buli ttabi eriri ku Nze eritabala bibala aliggyako—Yokaana 15:2

Wano tulina ekimu ku bigambo ebikulu mu lugero luno—ettabi. Omuzabbibu gwetaaga amatabi: awatali matabi teguliiko kye guyinza kukola, teguyinza kubala bibala. Nga bwe kikulu okumanya ku Muzabbibu ne ku Mulimi, bwe kityo bwe kikulu okutegeera ettabi kye liri. Nga tetunnawuliriza Kristo by’alina okwogera ku lyo, ka tusooke tutegeere ettabi kye liri, n’ekyo kye lituyigiriza ku bulamu bwaffe mu Kristo. Ettabi kitundu kya muti bukitundu, omuzabbibu kye gumeza olw’ekigendererwa kimu kyokka: okuguweereza mu kubala ebibala byagwo. Lirina obutonde bwe bumu n’omuzabbibu, era lirina obulamu bumu n’omwoyo gumu nagwo. Lowooza akaseera katono ku by’okuyiga kino bye kituleetera.

Waliwo eky’okuyiga ekya okwewaayo okujjuvu. Ettabi lirina ekigendererwa kimu kyokka kye liriwo, ensonga emu gye lyewaddeyo ddala. Ye eno: okubala ebibala omuzabbibu bye gwagala okuzaala. Era bw’atyo omukkiriza alina ensonga emu yokka lw’aba ettabi—ensonga emu yokka lw’ali ku nsi —Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu gulyoke guzaale ebibala bye nga guyita mu ye. Emmeeme ya mukisa emanyi kino, ekikkirizza, era egamba nti, Nnanunulibwa era mbeerawo olw’ekintu kimu kyokka—nga ettabi ery’omu nsi bwe libaawo olw’okubala ebibala kyokka, nange bwe ntyo; nga Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu bwe gubaawo olw’okubala ebibala kyokka, nange bwe ntyo. Nga bwe nsimbiddwa Katonda mu Kristo, nneewaddeyo ddala okubala ebibala Omuzabbibu bye gwagala okuzaala.

Waliwo eky’okuyiga ekya okufaanana okutuukiridde. Ettabi lifaanana ddala omuzabbibu mu buli ngeri—obutonde bwe bumu, obulamu bwe bumu, ekifo kye kimu, omulimu gwe gumu. Mu bino byonna byombi biri kimu, tebyawukana. Era bw’atyo omukkiriza yeetaaga okumanya nti agabana ku butonde bw’obwakatonda, era nti alina mu ye obutonde n’omwoyo bya Kristo ddala, era nti okuyitibwa kwe okumu kwe kwewaayo afaanane Kristo mu bujjuvu. Ettabi kye kifaananyi ky’omuzabbibu ekituukiridde; enjawulo yokka eri nti: ogumu munene era gwa maanyi, era ye nsibuko y’amaanyi; eddala ttono era linafu, bulijjo lyetaaga amaanyi era ligafuna. Bw’atyo n’omukkiriza ali, era alina okubeera, ekifaananyi kya Kristo ekituukiridde.

Waliwo eky’okuyiga ekya okwesigama okujjuvu. Omuzabbibu gulina ebiterekero byagwo eby’obulamu, n’amazzi gaagwo, n’amaanyi, si ku lwagwo, wabula ku lw’amatabi. Amatabi tegaliiko kye gali era tegaliiko kye galina okuggyako omuzabbibu bye gugawa era bye gugagabira. Omukkiriza ayitibwa—era kye kisingayo okumuwa omukisa okukiyingiramu—mu bulamu obw’okwesigama ku Kristo ddala, awatali kulekera. Emisana n’ekiro, buli kaseera, Kristo y’alina okukola mu ye byonna by’ayetaaga.

Era oluvannyuma eky’okuyiga ekya obwesige obutabuusabuusa. Ettabi teririna kye lyeraliikirira; omuzabbibu gugaba byonna; lyo lirina kwewaayo n’okufuna. Okulaba amazima gano kye kituusa ku kiwummulo eky’omukisa eky’okukkiriza, ekyama ekituufu eky’okukula n’amaanyi: “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.”

Nga twandifunye obulamu bwa kitalo singa twakkiriza bukkiriza okubeera amatabi! Mwana wa Katonda omwagalwa, yiga eky’okuyiga kino. Olina ekintu kimu kyokka eky’okukola: Beera ttabi kyokka—tosukkawo, tokendeezaako! Beera ttabi bubeezi; Kristo anaabeeranga Omuzabbibu agaba byonna. Era Omulimi, Katonda ow’amaanyi, eyafuula Omuzabbibu kye guli, bw’atyo ddala bw’alifuula ettabi kye lisaanidde okubeera.

Mukama Yesu, nkwegayiridde, mbikkulira ekyama eky’omu ggulu eky’ettabi, mu kwegatta kwalyo okulamu n’Omuzabbibu, ne mu ddembe lyalyo okutwala ku bujjuvu bwagwo bwonna. Era obumala bwo mu byonna, obukwata amatabi go ne bugajjuza, bunnuŋŋamye mu kiwummulo eky’okukkiriza ekimanyi nti ggwe okola byonna.

fields.title: Ekibala
fields.body_html:
Buli ttabi eriri ku Nze eritabala bibala aliggyako—Yokaana 15:2

Ekibala.—Kino kye kigambo ekikulu ekiddako kye tulina: Omuzabbibu, Omulimi, ettabi, ekibala. Mukama waffe atugamba ki ku kibala? Kino kyokka—nti ekibala kye kintu kyokka ettabi kye libeererawo, era nti bwe litabala bibala, omulimi aliggyako. Omuzabbibu kye kitiibwa ky’omulimi; ettabi kye kitiibwa ky’omuzabbibu; ekibala kye kitiibwa ky’ettabi; ettabi bwe litabala bibala, teririimu kitiibwa wadde omugaso; liba kyesittaza era kiziyiza; omulimi aliggyako. Ensonga emu yokka lwaki ettabi weeriri, akabonero kamu kokka akalaga nti ttabi lya mazima ku Muzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu, n’obukwakkulizo bumu bwokka Omulimi ow’obwakatonda bw’assaawo okulikkiriza okugabana ku bulamu Omuzabbibu bwe guli, bwe buno—okubala ebibala.

Kale ekibala kye ki? Kye kintu ettabi kye libala, si ku lwalyo, wabula ku lwa nnannyini lyo; kye kintu ekiteekwa okunogebwa ne kitwalibwa. Ddala ettabi lifuna okuva ku muzabbibu amasanda ag’obulamu bwalyo, era olw’ago ligejja ne lyeyongera amaanyi. Naye bye lifuna okulyekuuma byonna biri wansi ddala w’okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ky’okubeerawo kwalyo—okubala ebibala. Abakristaayo kye bava balemererwa ennyo mu kufuba kwabwe ne mu kusaba kwabwe okubeera n’obulamu bw’ettabi, kubanga tebategeera era tebakkiriza mazima gano. Emirundi mingi babwegomba nnyo; basoma, ne bafumiitiriza, ne basaba, naye ne balemererwa, ne beebuuza nti lwaki? Ensonga nnyangu nnyo: tebamanyi nti okubala ebibala kye kintu kyokka kye baalokolerwa. Nga Kristo bwe yafuuka ddala Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima olw’ekigendererwa ekyo kimu, naawe bw’otyo wafuulibwa ettabi, olw’ekigendererwa kimu kyokka eky’okubala ebibala olw’okulokolebwa kw’abantu. Omuzabbibu n’ettabi byombi biri wansi w’etteeka eritakyuka ery’okubala ebibala, nga y’ensonga yokka lwaki bibaawo. Kristo n’omukkiriza, Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu n’ettabi, bombi balina ekifo kyabwe mu nsi olw’ekigendererwa kimu kyokka: okutwala eri abantu okwagala kwa Katonda okulokola. Kyekiva kibaawo ekigambo kino ekikulu: Buli ttabi eriri ku Nze eritabala bibala aliggyako.

Ka twegendereze nnyo ensobi emu ennene. Abakristaayo bangi balowooza nti obulokozi bwabwe bo kye kintu ekisooka; obulamu bwabwe obw’ensi kuno n’okugaggawala, wamu n’okulabirira amaka gaabwe, bye biddako; n’ebiseera n’omwoyo ebisigaddewo biyinza okuweebwayo eri okubala ebibala, eri okulokola abantu. Tekyewuunyisa nti emirundi egisinga obungi ebiseera n’omwoyo ebisigalawo biba bitono nnyo. Nedda, ggwe Omukristaayo, ekigendererwa kimu kyokka lwaki wafuulibwa ekitundu ky’Omubiri gwa Kristo, kwe kuba nti Omutwe akukozese okutuukiriza omulimu gwe ogw’okulokola. Ekigendererwa kimu kyokka Katonda kye yalina mu kukufuula ettabi, kwe kuba nti Kristo ng’ayita mu ggwe aleete obulamu eri abantu. Obulokozi bwo ggwe kennyini, emirimu gyo n’okulabirira amaka go, byonna biri wansi ddala w’ekyo. Ekigendererwa kyo ekisooka mu bulamu, ekigendererwa kyo ekisooka buli lunaku, kisaanidde kuba kumanya Kristo bw’ayagala okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kye mu ggwe.

Ka tutandike okulowooza nga Katonda bw’alowooza. Ka tukkirize okuyigiriza kwa Kristo era tukwanukule. Ekigendererwa kimu kyokka lwaki ndi ttabi, akabonero kamu kokka akalaga nti ndi ttabi lya mazima, obukwakkulizo bumu bwokka obw’okubeera kwange mu Ye n’okweyongera amaanyi, kwe kubala ekibala ky’Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu, abantu abafa bakirye babeere balamu. Era ekintu kimu kye nsobola okukakasa ennyo okusinga byonna kye kino: nga Kristo ye Muzabbibu wange, ne Kitaffe nga ye Mulimi wange, ddala nsobola okuba ettabi eribala ebibala.

Kitaffe, ojja ng’onoonya ebibala. Tukwegayiridde, tuyigirize okutegeera nti ddala kino kye kigendererwa kimu kyokka eky’okubeerawo kwaffe, n’eky’okwegatta kwaffe ne Kristo. Kifuule okwegomba kumu kwokka okw’emitima gyaffe okuba amatabi agajjudde ennyo Omwoyo w’Omuzabbibu, ne tubala ebibala bingi nnyo.

Kitaffe, ojja ng’onoonya ebibala. Tukwegayiridde, tuyigirize okutegeera nti ddala kino kye kigendererwa kimu kyokka eky’okubeerawo kwaffe, n’eky’okwegatta kwaffe ne Kristo. Kifuule okwegomba kumu kwokka okw’emitima gyaffe okuba amatabi agajjudde ennyo Omwoyo w’Omuzabbibu, ne tubala ebibala bingi nnyo.

fields.title: Ebibala Ebisingawo
fields.body_html:
Naye buli ttabi eribala ebibala, alirongoosa lyeyongerenga okubala—Yokaana 15:2

Ekirowoozo ky’ekibala kyeyoleka nnyo mu maaso g’Oyo alaba ebintu nga bwe biri, era ekibala ddala kye kintu kimu kyokka Katonda kye yassaako omutima gwe, ne kiba nti Mukama waffe bw’amala okugamba nti ettabi eritabala bibala liggibwako, amangu ago n’ayongerako nti: era awali ekibala, okwegomba kumu kwokka okw’Omulimi bye bibala ebisingawo. Ng’ekirabo ky’ekisa kye, ng’akabonero k’amaanyi ag’omwoyo, ng’okwolesebwa kw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’ekya Kristo, era ng’ekkubo lyokka ery’okumala obwetaavu bw’ensi, Katonda ayaayaanira ebibala ebisingawo, era abiteekerateekera.

Ebibala Ebisingawo—Kino kigambo ekikebera ennyo. Ng’amakanisa era ng’abantu kinnoomu, tewali kabi ke tulimu kasinga ak’okwematiza. Omwoyo ogwekusifu ogwa Lawodikiya—Ndi mugagga era nnina ebintu bingi, sso siriiko kye neetaaga—guyinza okufuga awantu we gutateeberezebwa. Okulabula okuva eri Katonda—munaku asaasirwa, omwavu—kufuna abakwanukula batono ddala awo wennyini we kusinga okwetaagibwa.

Tetumatiranga olw’ekirowoozo nti tukola omugabo gwaffe kyenkanyi n’abalala mu mulimu ogukolebwa, oba nti abantu bamativu n’okufuba kwaffe mu kuweereza Kristo, oba nti n’okutulaga batulaga ng’ekyokulabirako. Okwegomba kwaffe kwokka kubeere kumanya oba ddala tubala ebibala byonna Kristo by’ayagala okuwa ng’ayita mu ffe ng’amatabi amalamu, agegasse naye ennyo mu bulamu, era oba tumatiza omutima ogw’okwagala ogw’Omulimi omukulu, Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, mu kwegomba kwe okw’ebibala ebisingawo.

Ebibala Ebisingawo—Ekigambo kino kijja n’obuyinza obw’obwakatonda okukebera n’okugezesa obulamu bwaffe: omuyigirizwa ow’amazima ajja kwewaayo n’omutima gwe gwonna eri ekitangaala kyakyo ekitukuvu, era ajja kusaba n’obunyiikivu Katonda yennyini amulage ekiyinza okubulawo mu bungi oba mu mbala y’ebibala by’abala. Ddala ka tukkirize nti Ekigambo kino kigendereddwamu okututwala mu maaso okumanyira ddala n’obujjuvu ekigendererwa kya Kitaffe eky’okwagala, obujjuvu bwa Kristo, n’enkizo ey’ekitalo ey’okubala ebibala bingi mu kulokolebwa kw’abantu.

Ebibala Ebisingawo—Kino kigambo ekizzaamu ennyo amaanyi. Ka tukiwulirize. Obubaka buno—ebibala ebisingawo—bujjira ddala ettabi eriba libala ebibala. Katonda takisaba nga Falaawo omukozesa w’abaddu, oba nga Musa omuwi w’amateeka, nga tawadde bya kukikolesa. Ajja nga Kitaffe, awa ky’asaba, era akola ky’alagira. Ajja gye tuli ffe amatabi amalamu ag’Omuzabbibu omulamu, n’atuwa okukola mu ffe ebibala ebisingawo, kasita twewaayo mu mikono gye. Tetugenda kukkiriza ky’atusaba, ne tutwala ky’atuwa, ne tumutunuulira akikole mu ffe?

“lyeyongerenga okubala”: ddala ka tukkirize nti nga nnannyini muzabbibu bw’akola buli kimu okulaba nti ebibala biba bingi era binene nga bwe kisoboka, bw’atyo Omulimi ow’obwakatonda alikola byonna ebyetaagisa okutubaza ebibala ebisingawo. Ky’atusaba kyokka kwe kuba nti tukyegomba n’omutima gwaffe gwonna, twewaayo eri okukola kwe n’okulabirira kwe, era tumutunuulire n’essanyu akole omulimu gwe ogutuukiridde mu ffe. Katonda yassa omutima gwe ku bibala ebisingawo; Kristo alindirira okubikola mu ffe; ka tutunuulire n’essanyu Omulimi waffe ow’obwakatonda n’Omuzabbibu gwaffe ogw’omu ggulu, okukakasa nti tubala ebibala ebisingawo.

Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, ggwe Mulimi ow’omu ggulu. Era Kristo ye Muzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu. Nange ndi ttabi ery’omu ggulu, erigabana ku bulamu bwe obw’omu ggulu, okubala ebibala bye eby’omu ggulu. Kitaffe, amaanyi g’obulamu bwe gajjule mu nze bwe gatyo, ndyoke mbalenga bulijjo ebibala ebisingawo, olw’ekitiibwa ky’erinnya lyo.

fields.title: Okulongoosebwa
fields.body_html:
Buli ttabi eribala ebibala, alirongoosa lyeyongerenga okubala—Yokaana 15:2

Waliwo ebintu bibiri eby’enjawulo ku muzabbibu. Tewali kimera kirala ekibala byakyo birimu omwenge mungi bwe gutyo, era okuva mu byo omwenge mwe guyinza okusogolwa mu bungi, ng’omuzabbibu. Era tewali kimera kirala ekyanguwa bwe kityo okumeramu emiti egy’ensiko egiziyiza ebibala byakyo, era kyekiva kyetaaga okusalirwa okutalina kisa n’akatono. Wano we ndi ntunuulira mu ddirisa lyange ennimiro z’emizabbibu ennene: omulimu omukulu ogw’omulimi w’emizabbibu kwe kugisalira. Oyinza okuba n’omuzabbibu oguwaniriddwa ku miti nga emirandira gyagwo gikka wansi nnyo mu ttaka eddungi, ne kiba nti tegwetaaga kulimibwako, wadde kussibwako bigimusa, wadde kufukirirwa: naye okusalirwa tegusobola kukwewala, bwe guba gwa kubala bibala birungi. Emiti egimu gyetaaga okusalirwa olumu na lumu; emirala gibala ebibala ebituukiridde nga tegisaliddwako n’akatono: naye omuzabbibu gwo guteekwa okusalirwa. Noolwekyo Mukama waffe atugamba, wano ku ntandikwa ddala ey’olugero, nti omulimu ogumu Kitaffe gw’akola ku ttabi eribala ebibala gwe guno: alirongoosa lyeyongerenga okubala.

Lowooza akaseera katono ku kino okusalira oba okulongoosa kwe kuli. Si kuggyawo muddo oba amaggwa, oba ekintu kyonna ekiva ebweru ekiyinza okulemesa okukula. Nedda; kwe kusalako ebisansa ebiwanvu eby’omwaka oguwedde, kwe kuggyawo ekintu ekiva munda, ekyazaalibwa obulamu bw’omuzabbibu bwennyini. Kwe kuggyawo ekintu ekiraga amaanyi g’obulamu bwagwo; gye gukoma okukula n’amaanyi, gye kikoma okwetaagisa okugusalira. Emiti emirungi era emiramu egy’omuzabbibu gye giteekwa okusalibwako. Lwaki? Kubanga okujjuza ebisansa byonna ebiwanvu eby’okukula kw’omwaka oguwedde kwandimaze amasanda mangi nnyo: amasanda gateekwa okuterekebwa ne gakozesebwa ku bibala byokka. Amatabi, oluusi agawanvu ffuti munaana n’ekkumi, gasalibwa okumpi ddala n’omukonda, ne wataba kisigalawo okuggyako yinci emu oba bbiri ez’omuti, ezimala okubala ebibala by’omuzabbibu. Ebintu byonna ebitali bya mugaso eri okubala ebibala bwe biba bisaliddwako awatali kisa, n’amatabi ne gasigalawo matono nga bwe kisoboka, olwo nno ebibala ebijjuvu era ebingi we biyinza okusuubirwa.

Eryo nga ssomo kkulu era lya muwendo! Okulongoosa kw’Omulimi wano tekwogera ku kibi kyokka. Kwogera ku mirimu gyaffe egy’eddiini, nga bwe gikula mu kubala ebibala kwennyini. Ekyo kye kiteekwa okusalibwako n’okulongoosebwa. Mu kukolera Katonda, tuteekwa okukozesa ebirabo byaffe eby’obuzaaliranwa: amagezi, oba obukugu mu kwogera, oba obuyinza ku balala, oba obunyiikivu. Naye bulijjo biri mu kabi ak’okukula okusukkiridde, ne tutandika okubyesiga. Noolwekyo, oluvannyuma lwa buli kiseera eky’omulimu, Katonda ateekwa okututuusa ku nkomerero yaffe ffennyini, okutegeera obunafu n’akabi ebiri mu byonna eby’omuntu, tuwulire nti tetuli kintu. Ekiteekwa okusigala ku ffe kye kyo kyokka ekimala okufuna amaanyi g’amasanda agawa obulamu ag’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Eby’omuntu biteekwa okukendeezebwa okutuuka ku kigero kyabyo ekisembayo wansi. Byonna ebitakwatagana na kwewaayo kwennyini eri okuweereza Kristo biteekwa okuggibwawo. Gye bikoma okutuukirira okulongoosa n’okusalako byonna ebiva mu ffe ffennyini, ne kikendeera ekifo Omwoyo Omutukuvu kw’alina okubuna, gye kikoma okweyongera okukuŋŋaanya obulamu bwaffe bwonna, tubeere ddala mu buyinza bw’Omwoyo. Kuno nno kwe kukomolebwa okutuufu: kwe kukomolebwa okubaawo mu mutima, kwe kukomolebwa okwa Kristo. Kuno kwe kukomererwa ne Kristo okw’amazima, nga tulaga okufa kwa Yesu bulijjo mu mibiri gyaffe.

Okulongoosa okw’omukisa, okulongoosa kwa Katonda yennyini! Nga tuyinza okusanyuka ennyo olw’obukakafu nti tulibala ebibala ebisingawo!

Ayi Mulimi waffe omutukuvu, longoosa era osaleko byonna ebiri mu ffe ebyagala okweraga, oba ebiyinza okufuuka ensibuko y’okwesiga amaanyi gaffe n’okwenyumiriza. Mukama, tukuume nga tuli wansi nnyo, waleme kubaawo muntu n’omu eyeenyumiriza mu maaso go. Ddala tukwesiga okukola omulimu gwo.

fields.title: Akambe Akasalira
fields.body_html:
Mmwe kaakano muli balongoofu olw’ekigambo kye mbagambye—Yokaana 15:3

Akambe akasalira ak’Omulimi ono ow’omu ggulu kye ki? Batera okugamba nti kwe kubonaabona. Nedda, si kye kisooka n’akatono. Kale olwo kyandibadde kitya eri bangi abamala ebiseera ebiwanvu nga tebalina bizibu; oba eri abamu Katonda b’alabika ng’abatonnyeseza ebirungi obulamu bwabwe bwonna? Nedda; akambe kye Kigambo kya Katonda. Kisala okusinga ekitala eky’obwogi obubiri, era kiyitamu ne kituukira ddala ku mmeeme n’omwoyo, era kyawula ebirowoozo n’okufumiitiriza kw’omutima. Okubonaabona kufuuka omukisa lwokka nga kututuusizza ku kukangavvulwa kuno okw’Ekigambo; obutaba na kulongoosebwa kuno okw’omutima okuyita mu Kigambo y’ensonga lwaki okubonaabona emirundi mingi tekututukuza. Wadde eriggwa mu mubiri lya Pawulo teryayinza kufuuka mukisa okutuusa ekigambo kya Kristo—“amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu”—bwe kyamulaga akabi k’okwegulumiza, ne kimufuula omwetegefu okusanyukira mu bunafu.

Ekigambo kye kambe akasalira aka Katonda. Yesu agamba nti: “Mmwe kaakano muli balongoofu olw’ekigambo kye mbagambye.” Ekigambo ekyo kyali kyogeddwa nga kikebera nnyo nnyini kitya Oyo eyalina ekitala ekyogi eky’obwogi obubiri mu kamwa ke, bwe yali abayigiriza! “Omuntu yenna ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka”; “alifiirwa obulamu bwe ku lwange”; “ateefiiriza byonna by’alina, tayinza kuba muyigirizwa wange”; “Oyo ayagala kitaawe oba nnyina okusinga Nze tansaanira”; oba bwe yakkakkanya amalala gaabwe, oba bwe yabanenya olw’obutaba na kwagala, oba bwe yalanga nga bonna bwe baali bagenda okumwabulira. Okuva ku ntandikwa y’obuweereza bwe mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi okutuuka ku bigambo bye eby’okulabula mu kiro ekisembayo, Ekigambo kye kyali kibagezesezza era kibalongoosezza. Yali azudde era asalidde omusango byonna ebyali ebyabwe bo bennyini; kaakano baali baggiddwamu byonna era nga balongoofu, nga beetegefu okuyingirwamu Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Emmeeme bw’eva ku birowoozo byayo yokka, n’ebirowoozo by’abantu ku ddiini kye ki, n’eyewaayo n’omutima gwayo gwonna, mu bwetoowaze ne mu bugumiikiriza, eri okuyigiriza kw’Ekigambo okuyita mu Mwoyo, olwo Kitaffe lw’alikola omulimu gwe ogw’omukisa ogw’okusalira n’okulongoosa byonna eby’obuzaaliranwa n’eby’obwomuntu ebyetabika mu mulimu gwaffe ne biziyiza Omwoyo we. Ekigambo ekinenya kijja kuteekateeka ekkubo ly’ekigambo ekibudaabuda era eky’essuubi, era Kitaffe alibalongoosa okuyita mu Kigambo.

Mmwe mwenna amatabi g’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, buli lwe musoma oba lwe muwulira Ekigambo, musooke okumulindirira akikozese okulongoosa ettabi. Muteeke omutima gwammwe ku kwegomba kwe okw’ebibala ebisingawo. Mumwesige ng’Omulimi okubikola. Mwewaayo mu kwewaayo okwangu ng’okw’abaana abato eri omulimu ogulongoosa ogw’Ekigambo kye n’Omwoyo we, era muyinza okukakasa nti ekigendererwa kye kirituukirizibwa mu mmwe.

Kitaffe, nkwegayiridde, ndongoosa okuyita mu Kigambo kyo. Kikebere era kiyoleke byonna eby’obwomuntu n’eby’omubiri ebiri mu ddiini yange. Kisaleko buli kikolo ky’okwesiga amaanyi gange, Omuzabbibu gulyoke gunsange nga ndi mwetegefu ddala okufuna obulamu bwe n’Omwoyo we. fields.title: Mubeere mu Nze
fields.body_html:
Mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe—Yokaana 15:4

Ettabi eggya bwe liyungibwa ku muzabbibu ne libeera omwo, wabaawo emitendera ebiri. Ogusooka gubeera mu muti gwennyini. Ettabi eriyungiddwa lisindika emirandira gyalyo emitono n’obuwuzi wansi mu kikolo, n’ekikolo ne kikula ne kiyingira mu ttabi eryo, ne wabaawo kye bayita okugattibwa okw’omubiri. Ettabi libeera omwo ne lifuuka kimu n’omuzabbibu, era newakubadde omuzabbibu gwandifudde, lyandisigadde muti gumu nagwo. Olwo ne wabaawo omutendera ogwokubiri: amazzi g’obulamu ag’omuzabbibu gayingira mu kitundu ekyo ekiggya, ne gakikozesa ng’omukutu mwe gayita okulinnya, ne geeyoleka mu mitunsi emito, mu bikoola ne mu bibala. Kuno kwe kugattibwa okw’obulamu. Ettabi eriyungiddwa bwe libeera mu kikolo, ekikolo nakyo kiriyingiramu n’amazzi gaakyo ag’obulamu okubeera mu lyo.

Mukama waffe bw’agamba nti: “mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe,” alaga ekintu ekifaanana bwe kityo. “mubeere mu Nze”: ekyo kisinga kwogera ku kye tulina okukola ffe. Tulina okwesiga n’okugondera, okweyawula ku bintu ebirala byonna, okumugololera emikono n’okumwekwatako, okwennyika mu Ye. Bwe tukola bwe tutyo, olw’ekisa ky’atuwa, empisa zizimbibwa, n’omutima ne gutegekebwa okufuna ekisingawo: “nange mbeere mu mmwe.” Katonda atugumya n’amaanyi olw’Omwoyo we mu muntu ow’omunda, era Kristo n’abeera mu mutima olw’okukkiriza.

Abakkiriza bangi basaba era beegomba nnyo okujjuzibwa Omwoyo n’okubeeramu kwa Kristo, ne beewuunya lwaki tebeeyongera mu maaso. Ensonga emirundi mingi y’eno: “nange mbeere mu mmwe” tekuyinza kujja kubanga “mubeere mu Nze” tekukuumibwa. “Omubiri nga bwe guli ogumu, n’Omwoyo omu”; Omwoyo nga tannajjuza, walina okubaawo omubiri ogutegekeddwa. Ettabi eriyungiddwa lirina okusooka okukulira mu kikolo n’okubeera omwo, amazzi g’obulamu nga tegannayitamu kuleeta bibala. Bwe tugoberera Kristo mu buwulize obw’obwetoowaze, ne mu bintu eby’okungulu, nga twefiiriza, nga tuleka ensi, era ne mu mubiri nga tunoonya okumufaanana — bwe tunoonya bwe tutyo okubeera mu Ye, lwe tulisobola okufuna n’okunyumirwa “nange mbeere mu mmwe.” Omulimu ogututeekeddwako: “mubeere mu Nze,” gulitutegekera omulimu Ye yennyini gw’akola: “nange mbeere mu mmwe.”

Mu—Ebitundu ebibiri eby’ekiragiro kino bifuna obumu bwabyo mu kigambo ekyo eky’omu makkati ekirina amakulu amazito: “mu.” Tewali kigambo mu Byawandiikibwa ekisinga kino obuzito. Katonda ali mu byonna. Katonda abeera mu Kristo. Kristo abeera mu Katonda. Ffe tuli mu Kristo. Kristo ali mu ffe: obulamu bwaffe nga butwaliddwa mu bubwe; obulamu bwe nga buweereddwa mu bwaffe; mu mazima ag’obwakatonda ebigambo ge bitayinza kunnyonnyola, tuli mu Ye era Ye ali mu ffe. Era ebigambo nti, “mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe,” bitugamba bugambi okukikkiriza, ekyama kino eky’obwakatonda, n’okwesiga Katonda waffe Omulimi ne Kristo Omuzabbibu, okukifuula eky’amazima mu ngeri ey’obwakatonda. Tewali kulowooza, newakubadde kuyigiriza, newakubadde kusaba, okuyinza okukitegeera; kyama kya kwagala okw’obwakatonda. Nga bwe tutayinza kuleeta kugattibwa kuno, bwe tutyo bwe tutayinza kukutegeera. Ka tutunuulire bututunuulizi Omuzabbibu ono ataliiko kkomo, ow’obwakatonda, ow’obuyinza bwonna, ng’atwagala, ng’atukutte, era ng’akolera mu ffe. Mu kukkiriza okwesiga okukola kwe, ka tubeere era tuwummulire mu Ye, nga buli kiseera tukyusiza omutima n’essuubi gy’ali yekka. Era ka tumwesige okutuukiriza mu ffe ekyama kino: “nga muli mu Nze, nga nange ndi mu mmwe.”

Mukama Omutendereze, ondagira okubeera mu Ggwe. Nnyinza ntya, Mukama, okuggyako nga weeraga gye ndi, ng’olindiridde okunnyaniriza, okunsembeza n’okunkuuma? Nkwegayiridde ondage engeri Ggwe, ng’Omuzabbibu, gy’otwala obuvunaanyizibwa okukola byonna. Okwemalira ku Ggwe kwe kubeera mu Ggwe. Nze wuuno, Mukama, ettabi, eryalongoosebwa era erikubeeramu — nga liwummulidde mu Ggwe, era nga lirindirira obulamu bwo n’ekisa kyo okukulukutira mu lyo.

fields.title: Bwe Mutabeera mu Nze
fields.body_html:
Ng’ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze—Yokaana 15:4

Tumanyi amakulu g’ekigambo okuggyako. Kitegeeza obukwakkulizo obutayinza kuggyibwawo, etteeka eritayinza kwewalibwa. “Ng’ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze.” Waliwo ekkubo limu lyokka ettabi mwe liyinza okubalira ebibala, tewali ngeri ndala: lirina okubeera mu kussa ekimu n’omuzabbibu okutakutuka. Ebibala tebiva mu ttabi lyennyini, wabula biva mu muzabbibu mwokka. Kristo yali amaze okugamba nti: “mubeere mu Nze”; mu butonde ettabi lituyigiriza essomo lino bulungi nnyo; nkizo ya kitalo nnyo okuyitibwa n’okukkirizibwa okubeera mu Muzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu; omuntu yandiyinzizza okulowooza nti tekyali kyetaagisa kwongerako bigambo bino eby’okulabula. Naye nedda — Kristo amanyi bulungi nnyo okwefiiriza okuli mu kino: “mubeere mu Nze”; engeri ffenna gye twandisikiriziddwa ennyo okunoonya okubala ebibala ku lw’amaanyi gaffe; era nga kyandibadde kizibu nnyo okutukkirizisa nti okubeera mu Ye okw’amazima era okutakoma kyetaagisa ddala! Akakasa nnyo amazima gano: ettabi teriyinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo; nga teriri ku muzabbibu, teriyinza kubala. “bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze.”

Naye ekyo kirina okutwalibwa nga bwe kiri ddala? Nze, nga ettabi bwe libeera mu muzabbibu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, erirabika, etakoma era etuukiridde, nange nnina okwewaayo mu ngeri y’emu okufuna obulamu bwange bwonna mu Kristo yekka? Weewaawo, nnina. Ekigambo bwe mutabeera kikwata buli muntu nga ekigambo nga teriri ku muzabbibu bwe kikwata buli ttabi. Ekigambo bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza tekirina kuggyibwako wadde kukyusibwa. Bwe mba ow’okuba ettabi ery’amazima, bwe mba ow’okubala ebibala, bwe mba ow’okuba nga Kristo ng’Omuzabbibu bw’ayagala mbeere, obulamu bwange bwonna bulina okuweebwayo ddala okubeera mu Ye, nga obw’ettabi ery’omu butonde bwe buweebwayo okubeera mu muzabbibu gwalyo.

Ka nnyige essomo lino. Okubeera mu Kristo kulina okuba ekikolwa eky’okwagala kwange n’omutima gwonna. Nga bwe wabaawo amadaala mu kunoonya Katonda n’okumuweereza, “si na mutima ogutuukiridde,” oba “n’omutima gwabwe gwonna,” bwe kityo wayinza okubaawo amadaala mu kubeera mu Ye. Mu kuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri obulamu obw’obwakatonda butuyingiramu, naye tebufuga era tebujjuza mangu ago obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Ekyo kijja ng’ensonga ey’ekiragiro n’obuwulize. Waliwo akabi akatayogerekeka ak’obutewaayo n’omutima gwaffe gwonna okubeera mu Ye. Waliwo akabi akatayogerekeka ak’okwewaayo okukolera Katonda n’okubala ebibala, nga tulina kitono nnyo eky’okubeera okw’amazima, okwerekera ddala mu Kristo ne mu bulamu bwe n’omutima gwonna. Waliwo akabi akatayogerekeka ak’emirimu emingi n’ebibala ebitono, olw’okubulwa ekintu kino ekimu ekyetaagibwa. Tulina okuleka ebigambo bino, “ku bwalyo,” “nga teriri ku muzabbibu,” bikole omulimu gwabyo: okukebera n’okwanika, okusalira n’okulongoosa, byonna ebiri mu bulamu bwaffe eby’okwekakasa n’okwagala kwaffe ffekka; kino kirituwonya akabi kano akanene, era kirituteekateeka okuyigirizibwa Ye, ng’atubikkulira amakulu amajjuvu ag’ekigambo kino mu ffe: “mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe.”

Mukama waffe Omutendereze ayagala okutuggya ku ffe ffennyini ne ku maanyi gaffe, atuleete gy’ali ne mu maanyi ge. Ka tukkirize okulabula kuno, tukyukire gy’ali n’okutya kungi n’obuteesiga ffekka, akole omulimu gwe. Obulamu bwaffe, nga Bayibuli bw’egamba, “bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda!” Obulamu obwo kyama kya mu ggulu, ekikwekeddwa abagezi, ne mu Bakristaayo, ne kibikkulirwa abaana abato. Omwoyo ogw’omwana omuto guyiga nti obulamu buweebwa okuva mu ggulu buli lunaku na buli kaseera eri omwoyo akkiriza okuyigiriza kuno: “ku bwalyo,” “nga teriri ku muzabbibu,” era anoonya byonna bye yeetaaga mu Muzabbibu. Olwo okubeera mu Muzabbibu kufuuka si kirala wabula okwewaayo okw’emirembe okw’omwoyo, okuleka Kristo abe na byonna era akole byonna, mu bujjuvu nga ettabi mu butonde bwe litamanyi era bwe litanoonya kirala kyonna wabula omuzabbibu.

Mubeere mu Nze. Mpulidde, Mukama wange, nti buli kiragiro ky’owa, era ogaba n’amaanyi okukituukiriza. Bwe wagamba nti “Golokoka, otambule,” omulema n’abuuka; nkkiriza ekigambo kyo, “mubeere mu Nze,” ng’ekigambo eky’amaanyi, ekigaba amaanyi, era kaakano njogera nti: Weewaawo, Mukama, njagala, era nkubeeramu.
fields.body_text: Ng’ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze—Yokaana 15:4 Tumanyi amakulu g’ekigambo okuggyako. Kitegeeza obukwakkulizo obutayinza kuggyibwawo, etteeka eritayinza kwewalibwa. “Ng’ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze.” Waliwo ekkubo limu lyokka ettabi mwe liyinza okubalira ebibala, tewali ngeri ndala: lirina okubeera mu kussa ekimu n’omuzabbibu okutakutuka. Ebibala tebiva mu ttabi lyennyini, wabula biva mu muzabbibu mwokka. Kristo yali amaze okugamba nti: “mubeere mu Nze”; mu butonde ettabi lituyigiriza essomo lino bulungi nnyo; nkizo ya kitalo nnyo okuyitibwa n’okukkirizibwa okubeera mu Muzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu; omuntu yandiyinzizza okulowooza nti tekyali kyetaagisa kwongerako bigambo bino eby’okulabula. Naye nedda — Kristo amanyi bulungi nnyo okwefiiriza okuli mu kino: “mubeere mu Nze”; engeri ffenna gye twandisikiriziddwa ennyo okunoonya okubala ebibala ku lw’amaanyi gaffe; era nga kyandibadde kizibu nnyo okutukkirizisa nti okubeera mu Ye okw’amazima era okutakoma kyetaagisa ddala! Akakasa nnyo amazima gano: ettabi teriyinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo; nga teriri ku muzabbibu, teriyinza kubala. “bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze.” Naye ekyo kirina okutwalibwa nga bwe kiri ddala? Nze, nga ettabi bwe libeera mu muzabbibu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, erirabika, etakoma era etuukiridde, nange nnina okwewaayo mu ngeri y’emu okufuna obulamu bwange bwonna mu Kristo yekka? Weewaawo, nnina. Ekigambo bwe mutabeera kikwata buli muntu nga ekigambo nga teriri ku muzabbibu bwe kikwata buli ttabi. Ekigambo bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza tekirina kuggyibwako wadde kukyusibwa. Bwe mba ow’okuba ettabi ery’amazima, bwe mba ow’okubala ebibala, bwe mba ow’okuba nga Kristo ng’Omuzabbibu bw’ayagala mbeere, obulamu bwange bwonna bulina okuweebwayo ddala okubeera mu Ye, nga obw’ettabi ery’omu butonde bwe buweebwayo okubeera mu muzabbibu gwalyo. Ka nnyige essomo lino. Okubeera mu Kristo kulina okuba ekikolwa eky’okwagala kwange n’omutima gwonna. Nga bwe wabaawo amadaala mu kunoonya Katonda n’okumuweereza, “si na mutima ogutuukiridde,” oba “n’omutima gwabwe gwonna,” bwe kityo wayinza okubaawo amadaala mu kubeera mu Ye. Mu kuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri obulamu obw’obwakatonda butuyingiramu, naye tebufuga era tebujjuza mangu ago obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Ekyo kijja ng’ensonga ey’ekiragiro n’obuwulize. Waliwo akabi akatayogerekeka ak’obutewaayo n’omutima gwaffe gwonna okubeera mu Ye. Waliwo akabi akatayogerekeka ak’okwewaayo okukolera Katonda n’okubala ebibala, nga tulina kitono nnyo eky’okubeera okw’amazima, okwerekera ddala mu Kristo ne mu bulamu bwe n’omutima gwonna. Waliwo akabi akatayogerekeka ak’emirimu emingi n’ebibala ebitono, olw’okubulwa ekintu kino ekimu ekyetaagibwa. Tulina okuleka ebigambo bino, “ku bwalyo,” “nga teriri ku muzabbibu,” bikole omulimu gwabyo: okukebera n’okwanika, okusalira n’okulongoosa, byonna ebiri mu bulamu bwaffe eby’okwekakasa n’okwagala kwaffe ffekka; kino kirituwonya akabi kano akanene, era kirituteekateeka okuyigirizibwa Ye, ng’atubikkulira amakulu amajjuvu ag’ekigambo kino mu ffe: “mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe.” Mukama waffe Omutendereze ayagala okutuggya ku ffe ffennyini ne ku maanyi gaffe, atuleete gy’ali ne mu maanyi ge. Ka tukkirize okulabula kuno, tukyukire gy’ali n’okutya kungi n’obuteesiga ffekka, akole omulimu gwe. Obulamu bwaffe, nga Bayibuli bw’egamba, “bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda!” Obulamu obwo kyama kya mu ggulu, ekikwekeddwa abagezi, ne mu Bakristaayo, ne kibikkulirwa abaana abato. Omwoyo ogw’omwana omuto guyiga nti obulamu buweebwa okuva mu ggulu buli lunaku na buli kaseera eri omwoyo akkiriza okuyigiriza kuno: “ku bwalyo,” “nga teriri ku muzabbibu,” era anoonya byonna bye yeetaaga mu Muzabbibu. Olwo okubeera mu Muzabbibu kufuuka si kirala wabula okwewaayo okw’emirembe okw’omwoyo, okuleka Kristo abe na byonna era akole byonna, mu bujjuvu nga ettabi mu butonde bwe litamanyi era bwe litanoonya kirala kyonna wabula omuzabbibu. Mubeere mu Nze. Mpulidde, Mukama wange, nti buli kiragiro ky’owa, era ogaba n’amaanyi okukituukiriza. Bwe wagamba nti “Golokoka, otambule,” omulema n’abuuka; nkkiriza ekigambo kyo, “mubeere mu Nze,” ng’ekigambo eky’amaanyi, ekigaba amaanyi, era kaakano njogera nti: Weewaawo, Mukama, njagala, era nkubeeramu.

fields.title: Omuzabbibu (Yokaana 15:5)
fields.body_html:
Nze muzabbibu, mmwe matabi—Yokaana 15:5

Mu lunyiriri oluvuddeko Kristo yali yakamala okugamba nti: “mubeere mu Nze.” Yali alangiridde etteeka eddene eritakyuka erifuga obulamu bwa buli ttabi, ku nsi oba mu ggulu: “ku bwalyo”; “nga teriri ku muzabbibu.” Mu bigambo ebisooka eby’olugero yali yayogera dda nti: “Nze muzabbibu.” Kaakano addamu ebigambo ebyo. Ayagala tutegeere — kwata bulungi essomo lino, newakubadde nga lirabika lyangu, kye kisumuluzo ky’obulamu obw’okubeera mu Ye — nti engeri yokka ey’okugondera ekiragiro, “mubeere mu Nze,” kwe kussa amaaso n’omutima ku Ye yennyini. “mubeere mu Nze...Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima.” Weewaawo, yiga ekyama kino ekitukuvu okutuusa lw’onoolaba Kristo nga Ye Muzabbibu ogw’amazima, ogwetikka, ogugumya, ogugabira era oguzzaamu amaanyi amatabi gaagwo gonna, nga Ye y’abeera era y’akola mu buli ttabi byonna bye lyetaaga, era okubeera mu Ye kujja kwokka. Weewaawo, mwekalirize nga Ye Muzabbibu ogw’amazima, okutuusa lw’onootegeera nti kino kyama kya mu ggulu, era n’owalirizibwa okusaba Kitaffe akikubikkulire olw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu. Oyo Katonda gw’abikkulira ekitiibwa ky’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, oyo alaba Yesu ky’ali era ky’alindirira okukola buli kaseera, tayinza butabeera mu Ye. Okulaba Kristo kusikiriza okutayinza kuziyizibwa; kutusika era kutukwata nga magineeti. Wuliriza bulijjo Kristo omulamu akyayogera naawe, era alindirira okukulaga amakulu n’amaanyi g’Ekigambo kye: “Nze muzabbibu.”

Nga kubadde kufuba kungi okukooya mu kugezaako okutegeera okubeera mu Ye kye kuli, n’okufuba kungi okutaliimu bibala mu kugezaako okukutuukako! Lwaki kyali bwe kityo? Kubanga amaaso gaali gatunuulidde okubeera ng’omulimu gwe tulina okukola, mu kifo ky’okutunuulira Kristo omulamu, mwe twalina okukuumirwa nga tubeera, era Ye yennyini eyalina okutukwata n’okutukuuma. Twalowooza nti okubeera mu Ye kufuba n’okwerumya okutakoma — ne twerabira nti kitegeeza okuwummula okuva mu kufuba eri oyo azudde ekifo kye eky’okubeeramu. Weetegereze nga Kristo bwe yagamba nti, “Mubeere mu Nze; Nze Muzabbibu oguleeta ebibala, ogukwata, ogugumya era ogubaza amatabi. Mubeere mu Nze, muwummulire mu Nze, mundeke nkole omulimu gwange. Nze Muzabbibu ogw’amazima; byonna bye ndi, bye njogera ne bye nkola mazima ga Katonda, agaleeta ekyo ekyogeddwa okubaawo ddala. Nze Muzabbibu; kkiriza bukkiriza, ompe byonna by’olina, nange ndikola byonna mu ggwe.”

Era bwe kityo oluusi kibaawo nti emyoyo egitalowoozanga nnyo ku ky’okubeera mu Ye, giba nga gibeera mu Ye ebbanga lyonna, kubanga gyemalidde ku Kristo. Si kuba nti ekigambo okubeera tekyetaagisa; Kristo yakikozesa emirundi mingi, kubanga kye kisumuluzo kyennyini eky’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo. Naye ayagala tukitegeere mu makulu gaakyo ag’amazima: “Va mu buli kifo ekirala, ne mu buli kwesiga kulala na buli kikutwala kirala, va mu ggwe wennyini n’okulowooza kwo n’okufuba kwo, jjangu owummulire mu ekyo kye ndikola. Beera mulamu ebweru wa ggwe wennyini; beera mu Nze. Manya nti oli mu Nze; teweetaaga kirala; sigala omwo mu Nze.”

“Nze muzabbibu.” Kristo teyakweka kyama kino abayigirizwa be. Yakibabikkulira, okusooka mu bigambo wano, oluvannyuma mu maanyi Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yakka. Naffe alikitubikkulira, okusooka mu birowoozo, mu kwatula ne mu kwegomba ebigambo bino bye bizuukusa, oluvannyuma mu maanyi olw’Omwoyo. Ka tumulindirire atulage amakulu gonna ag’omu ggulu ag’ekyama kino. Buli lunaku, mu kiseera kyaffe eky’ekisirise, mu kisenge eky’omunda nga tuli naye n’Ekigambo kye, ekirowoozo kyaffe n’ekigendererwa kyaffe ekikulu kibe okunywereza omutima ku Ye, nga tukakasa nti: byonna omuzabbibu bye guyinza okukolera amatabi gaagwo, Mukama wange Yesu alibinkolera, era abinkolera kaakano. Muwe ebiseera, muwe okutu kwo, akwogerere mpola era akunnyonnyole ekyama ky’obwakatonda: “Nze muzabbibu.”

Okusinga byonna, jjukira nti Kristo ye Muzabbibu Katonda gwe yasimba, naawe oli ttabi Katonda lye yayunga. Bulijjo yimirira mu maaso ga Katonda, mu Kristo; bulijjo lindirira ekisa kyonna okuva eri Katonda, mu Kristo; bulijjo weewaayo okubala ebibala ebisingawo Omulimi by’asaba, mu Kristo. Era saba nnyo okubikkulirwa ekyama kino nti okwagala kwonna n’amaanyi gonna aga Katonda agaali ku Kristo, gakolera ne mu ggwe. Yesu agamba nti, “Nze Muzabbibu gwa Katonda; byonna bye ndi mbirina okuva gy’ali; byonna bye ndi bya ggwe; Katonda alibikola mu ggwe.”

Nze muzabbibu. Mukama Omutendereze, kyogere ekigambo ekyo mu mwoyo gwange. Olwo ndimanya nti obujjuvu bwo bwonna bwange. Era nti nsobola okukwesiga okubukulukusa mu nze, era nti okubeera kwange mu Ggwe kwangu nnyo era kukakafu nnyo, bwe nneerabira ne nneebulira ddala mu kukkiriza okusinza nti Omuzabbibu gukwata ettabi era gulituusaako buli kye lyetaaga.

fields.title: Mmwe Matabi
fields.body_html:
Nze muzabbibu, mmwe matabi—Yokaana 15:5

Kristo yali amaze okwogera bingi ku ttabi; wano atuuka ku ngeri gye kikwata ku buli muntu: “Mmwe matabi ge mbadde njogerako. Nga Nze bwe ndi Omuzabbibu, eyeeyama okuba n’okukola byonna amatabi bye geetaaga, bwe ntyo kaakano mbasaba, mu nteekateeka empya ey’Omwoyo Omutukuvu gwe mbadde mbasuubiza, mukkirize ekifo kye mbawa, mubeere matabi gange ku nsi.” Enkolagana gy’ayagala okuteekawo ya muntu ku muntu ddala: yonna yeesigamye ku bigambo ebibiri ebitono, Nze ne Ggwe. Era eri ffe ya muntu ku muntu nga bwe yali eri abayigirizwa abaasooka. Ka twanjule ffekka mu maaso ga Mukama waffe, okutuusa lw’anaayogera ne buli omu ku ffe mu maanyi, omwoyo gwaffe gwonna ne gukiwulira: “Nze Muzabbibu; ggwe ttabi.”

Omuyigirizwa wa Yesu omwagalwa, ne bw’oba omuto oba omunafu otya, wulira eddoboozi lino. “Ggwe ttabi.” Tolina kuba kitono ku ekyo. Toganya bwetoowaze obw’obulimba, wadde okutya okw’omubiri okw’okwefiiriza, wadde okubuusabuusa okw’obutakkiriza ku by’owulira nti osobola, okukuziyiza okwogera nti: “Ndiba ttabi, ne byonna ekyo bye kiyinza okutegeeza — ettabi, erinafu ennyo, naye nga lifaanana Omuzabbibu nga bwe kisoboka, kubanga ndi wa butonde bwe bumu, era nfuna ku mwoyo gwe gumu. Ettabi, eritalina bwe liyinza ddala, naye nga lyawuliddwa mu lwatu mu maaso ga Katonda n’abantu, nga liweereddwayo ddala eri omulimu gw’okubala ebibala, nga Omuzabbibu gwennyini. Ettabi, eritali kintu ku bwalyo, naye nga liwummudde era nga lisanyuka mu kukkiriza okumanyi nti Ye aligaba byonna. Weewaawo, olw’ekisa kye, siriba kitono ku ttabi, ne byonna by’ayagala libe, Ye alyoke abale ebibala bye ng’ayita mu nze.”

Ggwe ttabi.—Teweetaaga kuba kisingawo ku ekyo. Teweetaaga, wadde akaseera kamu mu lunaku, okwetikka obuvunaanyizibwa bw’Omuzabbibu. Teweetaaga kuva mu kifo eky’okwesigama ddala ku Ye n’okumwesiga okutaliiko kkomo. N’ekisinga byonna, teweetaaga kweraliikirira ngeri gy’onootegeeramu ekyama kino, oba gy’onootuukirizaamu obukwakkulizo bwakyo, oba gy’onootuukamu ku kigendererwa kyakyo eky’omukisa. Omuzabbibu guligaba byonna era gulikola byonna. Kitaffe, Omulimi, akuuma okugattibwa kwo n’Omuzabbibu n’okukula kwo mu gwo. Teweetaaga kuba kisingawo ku ttabi. Ttabi bubeezi! Ekyo kibe ekigambo kyo eky’okujjukira; kirikukulembera mu kkubo ery’okwewaayo okutakoma eri okukola kwa Kristo, ery’obuwulize obw’amazima eri buli kiragiro kye, n’ery’okulindirira n’essanyu ekisa kye kyonna.

Waliwo omuntu yenna kaakano abuuza nti: “Nnyinza ntya okuyiga okwogera kino mu ngeri entuufu, ‘Ba ttabi bubeezi!’ n’okukiraga mu bulamu?” Omwoyo omwagalwa, embeera y’ettabi, amaanyi gaalyo, n’ebibala bye libala, byesigamye ddala ku Muzabbibu. N’obulamu bwo ng’ettabi bwesigamye ddala ku ngeri gy’otegeeramu Mukama waffe Yesu ky’ali. Noolwekyo toyawulangamu bigambo bino ebibiri: “Nze Muzabbibu — ggwe ttabi.” Obulamu bwo, amaanyi go n’ebibala byo byesigamye ku Mukama wo Yesu ky’ali! Noolwekyo musinze era omwesige; abeere kye weegomba kimu kyokka, era kye wemalirako kyokka mu mutima gwo. Era bw’owulira nti tomumanyi bulungi era nti toyinza kumumanya bulungi, jjukira bujjukizi nti kiri mu buvunaanyizibwa bwe ng’Omuzabbibu okwemanyisa gy’oli. Kino takikola mu birowoozo n’endowooza — nedda — wabula mu kukula okukwekeddwa munda mu bulamu obwewaddeyo mu bwetoowaze, mu mirembe era ddala, okumulindirira. Omuzabbibu gweyoleka munda mu ttabi; okuva awo okukula n’ebibala we bijjira. Kristo abeera era akolera munda mu ttabi lye; ba ttabi bubeezi, ng’omulindirira akole byonna; alikubeerera Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima. Kitaffe yennyini, Omulimi ow’obwakatonda, asobola okukufuula ettabi erisaanira Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu. Tolibulwa ky’osuubira.

Mmwe matabi. Ne kino, Mukama! Kyogere mu maanyi eri omwoyo gwange. Ettabi ly’omuzabbibu ogw’oku nsi lireme kunkwasa nsonyi, naye nga bwe libeerawo olw’okubala ebibala by’omuzabbibu kyokka, obulamu bwange ku nsi bulemenga kuba na kwegomba wadde kigendererwa kirala kyonna, wabula okukuleka Ggwe okubala ebibala ng’oyita mu nze.
fields.body_text: Nze muzabbibu, mmwe matabi—Yokaana 15:5 Kristo yali amaze okwogera bingi ku ttabi; wano atuuka ku ngeri gye kikwata ku buli muntu: “Mmwe matabi ge mbadde njogerako. Nga Nze bwe ndi Omuzabbibu, eyeeyama okuba n’okukola byonna amatabi bye geetaaga, bwe ntyo kaakano mbasaba, mu nteekateeka empya ey’Omwoyo Omutukuvu gwe mbadde mbasuubiza, mukkirize ekifo kye mbawa, mubeere matabi gange ku nsi.” Enkolagana gy’ayagala okuteekawo ya muntu ku muntu ddala: yonna yeesigamye ku bigambo ebibiri ebitono, Nze ne Ggwe. Era eri ffe ya muntu ku muntu nga bwe yali eri abayigirizwa abaasooka. Ka twanjule ffekka mu maaso ga Mukama waffe, okutuusa lw’anaayogera ne buli omu ku ffe mu maanyi, omwoyo gwaffe gwonna ne gukiwulira: “Nze Muzabbibu; ggwe ttabi.” Omuyigirizwa wa Yesu omwagalwa, ne bw’oba omuto oba omunafu otya, wulira eddoboozi lino. “Ggwe ttabi.” Tolina kuba kitono ku ekyo. Toganya bwetoowaze obw’obulimba, wadde okutya okw’omubiri okw’okwefiiriza, wadde okubuusabuusa okw’obutakkiriza ku by’owulira nti osobola, okukuziyiza okwogera nti: “Ndiba ttabi, ne byonna ekyo bye kiyinza okutegeeza — ettabi, erinafu ennyo, naye nga lifaanana Omuzabbibu nga bwe kisoboka, kubanga ndi wa butonde bwe bumu, era nfuna ku mwoyo gwe gumu. Ettabi, eritalina bwe liyinza ddala, naye nga lyawuliddwa mu lwatu mu maaso ga Katonda n’abantu, nga liweereddwayo ddala eri omulimu gw’okubala ebibala, nga Omuzabbibu gwennyini. Ettabi, eritali kintu ku bwalyo, naye nga liwummudde era nga lisanyuka mu kukkiriza okumanyi nti Ye aligaba byonna. Weewaawo, olw’ekisa kye, siriba kitono ku ttabi, ne byonna by’ayagala libe, Ye alyoke abale ebibala bye ng’ayita mu nze.” Ggwe ttabi.—Teweetaaga kuba kisingawo ku ekyo. Teweetaaga, wadde akaseera kamu mu lunaku, okwetikka obuvunaanyizibwa bw’Omuzabbibu. Teweetaaga kuva mu kifo eky’okwesigama ddala ku Ye n’okumwesiga okutaliiko kkomo. N’ekisinga byonna, teweetaaga kweraliikirira ngeri gy’onootegeeramu ekyama kino, oba gy’onootuukirizaamu obukwakkulizo bwakyo, oba gy’onootuukamu ku kigendererwa kyakyo eky’omukisa. Omuzabbibu guligaba byonna era gulikola byonna. Kitaffe, Omulimi, akuuma okugattibwa kwo n’Omuzabbibu n’okukula kwo mu gwo. Teweetaaga kuba kisingawo ku ttabi. Ttabi bubeezi! Ekyo kibe ekigambo kyo eky’okujjukira; kirikukulembera mu kkubo ery’okwewaayo okutakoma eri okukola kwa Kristo, ery’obuwulize obw’amazima eri buli kiragiro kye, n’ery’okulindirira n’essanyu ekisa kye kyonna. Waliwo omuntu yenna kaakano abuuza nti: “Nnyinza ntya okuyiga okwogera kino mu ngeri entuufu, ‘Ba ttabi bubeezi!’ n’okukiraga mu bulamu?” Omwoyo omwagalwa, embeera y’ettabi, amaanyi gaalyo, n’ebibala bye libala, byesigamye ddala ku Muzabbibu. N’obulamu bwo ng’ettabi bwesigamye ddala ku ngeri gy’otegeeramu Mukama waffe Yesu ky’ali. Noolwekyo toyawulangamu bigambo bino ebibiri: “Nze Muzabbibu — ggwe ttabi.” Obulamu bwo, amaanyi go n’ebibala byo byesigamye ku Mukama wo Yesu ky’ali! Noolwekyo musinze era omwesige; abeere kye weegomba kimu kyokka, era kye wemalirako kyokka mu mutima gwo. Era bw’owulira nti tomumanyi bulungi era nti toyinza kumumanya bulungi, jjukira bujjukizi nti kiri mu buvunaanyizibwa bwe ng’Omuzabbibu okwemanyisa gy’oli. Kino takikola mu birowoozo n’endowooza — nedda — wabula mu kukula okukwekeddwa munda mu bulamu obwewaddeyo mu bwetoowaze, mu mirembe era ddala, okumulindirira. Omuzabbibu gweyoleka munda mu ttabi; okuva awo okukula n’ebibala we bijjira. Kristo abeera era akolera munda mu ttabi lye; ba ttabi bubeezi, ng’omulindirira akole byonna; alikubeerera Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima. Kitaffe yennyini, Omulimi ow’obwakatonda, asobola okukufuula ettabi erisaanira Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu. Tolibulwa ky’osuubira. Mmwe matabi. Ne kino, Mukama! Kyogere mu maanyi eri omwoyo gwange. Ettabi ly’omuzabbibu ogw’oku nsi lireme kunkwasa nsonyi, naye nga bwe libeerawo olw’okubala ebibala by’omuzabbibu kyokka, obulamu bwange ku nsi bulemenga kuba na kwegomba wadde kigendererwa kirala kyonna, wabula okukuleka Ggwe okubala ebibala ng’oyita mu nze.

fields.title: Ebibala Bingi
fields.body_html:
Buli abeera mu Nze nange ne mbeera mu ye oyo abala ebibala bingi—Yokaana 15:5

Mukama waffe yali ayogedde ku bibala, n’ebibala ebisingawo. Kaakano ayongerako ekirowoozo kino: ebibala bingi. Mu Muzabbibu mulimu obujjuvu bungi nnyo, era okulabirira kw’Omulimi ow’obwakatonda tekuyinza kulemererwa, ne kiba nti ebibala ebingi si kye bakakibwa, wabula kisuubizo kyokka eky’ekyo ekiteekwa okujjira ettabi eriri mu kubeera okw’emirundi ebiri — ye mu Kristo, ne Kristo mu ye. “Oyo abala ebibala bingi.” Kya nkakafu.

Wali weetegerezza enjawulo eriwo mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo wakati w’omulimu n’ekibala? Ekyuma kiyinza okukola omulimu: obulamu bwokka bwe buyinza okubala ekibala. Etteeka liyinza okukaka omuntu okukola: okwagala kwokka kwe kuyinza okuzaala ekibala nga tekukakiddwa. Omulimu gutegeeza okufuba n’okutegana: naye ekibala, mu nsibuko yaakyo, kye kiva mu bulamu bwaffe obw’omunda mu kasirise, mu butonde, ne mu kuwummula. Omulimi w’ennimiro ayinza okutegana okuwa omuti gwe ogw’ebibala okulima, n’obusa, okufukirira n’okusalira bye gwetaaga; naye tayinza kukola kibala kyennyini: “ebibala eby’Omwoyo bye bino: okwagala, essanyu, emirembe.” Obulamu obuli obulungi bubala ebibala bingi. Enkolagana wakati w’omulimu n’ekibala oboolyawo esinga kulabikira mu bigambo bino: “mubala ebibala mu buli mulimu omulungi” (Abakkolosaayi 1:10). Emirimu emirungi gisiimibwa Katonda nga gijja lwa kuba bibala by’Omwoyo abeera mu ffe. Abantu bayinza okuba abanyiikivu ennyo mu mirimu emirungi nga bakakibwa etteeka n’omutima ogubalumiriza, oba nga basikirizibwa okwegomba n’obunyiikivu, naye ne basanga nga bye bivaamu eby’omwoyo bitono nnyo. Tewali nsonga ndala wabula eno — emirimu gyabwe kufuba kwa muntu, so si bibala by’Omwoyo, ebiva mu Mwoyo ng’akolera mu ffe mu butonde ne mu kuwummula.

Abakozi bonna bajje bawulirize Omuzabbibu waffe omutukuvu ng’abikkula etteeka ly’okubala ebibala ebikakafu era ebingi: “Buli abeera mu Nze nange ne mbeera mu ye oyo abala ebibala bingi.” Omulimi w’ennimiro afaayo ku kintu kimu — amaanyi n’obulamu obulungi bw’omuti gwe: ebibala bigoberera byokka. Bw’oba oyagala okubala ebibala, faayo obulamu bwo obw’omunda bubeere bulungi ddala, n’enkolagana yo ne Kristo Yesu ebeere ntangaavu era ya kumpi. Buli lunaku lutandike naye ku makya, omanye mu mazima nti obeera mu Ye ne Ye abeera mu ggwe. Kristo atugamba nti ekitali ekyo tekimala. Si kwagala kwo wadde okudduka kwo, si lwa maanyi go wadde obuyinza bwo, naye — “lwa Mwoyo wange,” bw’ayogera Mukama. Buli kiseera ekiggya ky’osisinkana, buli mulimu omuggya gw’otandika, gukole ng’okutu kwo n’omutima gwo biggule eri eddoboozi lya Mukama: “Buli abeera mu Nze nange ne mbeera mu ye oyo abala ebibala bingi.” Ggwe faayo ku kubeera mu Ye; Ye alifaayo ku bibala, kubanga y’alibiwa mu ggwe era ng’ayita mu ggwe.

Ow’oluganda wange, Kristo y’ateekwa okukola byonna! Omuzabbibu gwe guwa amasanda, n’obulamu, n’amaanyi: ettabi lirindirira, liwummula, likkiriza, era libala ebibala. Ayi, nga kya mukisa okuba amatabi bwerere, Omwoyo mw’ayita n’aleetera abantu obulamu bwa Katonda!

Nkwegayiridde, funa akaseera osabe Omwoyo Omutukuvu akuyambe okutegeera ekifo ekikulu ennyo ekitayogerekeka ky’olina mu birowoozo bya Katonda. Yakusimba mu Mwana we ng’akuyise era ng’akuwadde amaanyi okubala ebibala bingi. Kkiriza ekifo ekyo. Tunuulira nnyo Katonda ne Kristo, era osuubire n’essanyu okuba ekyo Katonda ky’ateeseteese okukufuula: ettabi eribala ebibala.

Ebibala bingi! Kibe bwe kityo, Mukama Yesu Omutendereze. Kiyinza okubaawo, kubanga Ggwe Muzabbibu. Kirituukirira, kubanga mbeera mu Ggwe. Kiteekwa okubaawo, kubanga Kitaawo ye Mulimi alongoosa ettabi. Weewaawo, ebibala bingi, okuva mu bungi bw’ekisa kyo.

fields.title: Temuliiko Kye Muyinza Kukola
fields.body_html:
Awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola—Yokaana 15:5

Mu buli kintu, obulamu bw’ettabi buteekwa okufaanana ddala n’obw’Omuzabbibu. Yesu yali ayogedde ku Ye yennyini nti: “Omwana taliiko ky’akola ku bubwe.” Ng’ekiva mu kwesigama okwo okujjuvu, yasobola okwongerako ng’ayogera ku Kitaffe nti: “ye by’akola n’Omwana by’akola.” Nga Mwana, teyaweebwa bulamu bwe okuva eri Kitaffe omulundi gumu ogw’olubeerera, wabula buli kaseera. Obulamu bwe bwali kulindirira Kitaffe obutasalako olwa byonna bye yali agenda okukola. Era bw’atyo Kristo agamba abayigirizwa be nti: “Awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola.” Kino akitegeeza nga bwe kiri ddala. Buli ayagala okubeera omuyigirizwa ow’amazima, okubala ebibala n’okugulumiza Katonda, atuukibwako obubaka buno: Temuliiko kye muyinza kukola. Ekyali kyogeddwa nti: “Buli abeera mu Nze nange ne mbeera mu ye oyo abala ebibala bingi,” wano kinywezebwa n’ensonga esinga obwangu n’amaanyi: “Okubeera mu Nze kwetaagisa ddala, tekuyinza kulekebwa, kubanga, mukimanyi, ku bwammwe temuliiko kye muyinza kukola okukuuma obulamu obw’omu ggulu wadde okubutambuliramu.”

Okukakasa ennyo nti ekigambo kino kya mazima kye kiri ku kikolo ddala eky’obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’amaanyi. Nga bwe sseetonda, era nga bwe sseeyinza kuzuukiza muntu mufu, bwe ntyo sseeyinza kwewa bulamu bwa Katonda. Era nga bwe sseeyinza kubwewa, bwe ntyo sseeyinza kubukuuma wadde okubwongera: buli kunyeenya kwabwo mulimu gwa Katonda ng’ayita mu Kristo ne mu Mwoyo we. Omuntu bw’akkiriza kino, kw’olwo w’atwala ekifo eky’okwesigama okujjuvu era okutasalako, nga ye nsibuko ddala ey’obulamu bw’okukkiriza. N’eriiso ery’omwoyo alaba Kristo buli kaseera ng’agaba ekisa olwa buli kussa omukka n’olwa buli kugenda mu buziba mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Omutima gwe gwonna gwogera nti Amiina eri ekigambo kino: Temuliiko kye muyinza kukola. Era lwa kuba akola bw’atyo, kyava asobola n’okugamba nti: “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.” Okutegeera obunafu bwaffe, n’okubeera mu Ye kwe butuwaliriza, bitutuusa ku kubala ebibala okw’amazima n’obunyiikivu mu mirimu emirungi.

Awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola.—Nga eno nsonga ya maanyi, era nga kuyita buli kaseera okubeera mu Kristo! Twetaaga kuddayo ku muzabbibu bwe tutyo tulabe nga kino bwe kiri eky’amazima. Tunuulira nate ettabi eryo ettono, eritaliiko kye lyesobolera era eritabala bibala wabula nga lifuna amasanda okuva mu muzabbibu, oyige nti okukakasa okujjuvu nti toyinza kukola kintu kyonna awatali Kristo kye kyennyini ky’oyetaaga okukuyigiriza okubeera mu Muzabbibu wo ow’omu ggulu. Ago ge makulu amakulu ag’okulongoosa Kristo kwe yayogerako — byonna ebyaffe ku bwaffe biteekwa okussibwa wansi, obwesige bwaffe bubeere mu Kristo yekka. “Mubeere mu Nze” — ebibala bingi! “Awatali Nze” — tewali kintu! Waliwo okubuusabuusa kwonna ku kye tunaalonda?

Ekyokuyiga ekimu eky’olugero luno kiri nti — nga bwe kiri ekikakafu era eky’obutonde ettabi okubeera mu muzabbibu, naawe oyinza okubeera mu Kristo. Kyeyava aba Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima; Katonda kyeyava aba Omulimi; kyewava oba ettabi. Tetwandikaabidde Katonda atununule emirembe gyonna okuva mu “awatali Nze,” era afuule “mubeere mu Nze” ekintu ekiriwo obutasalako? Omutima gwo gugende eri ekyo Kristo ky’ali, n’ekyo ky’ayinza okukola, eri obuyinza bwe obw’obwakatonda n’okwagala kwe okw’ekisa eri buli limu ku matabi ge, era olyogera bulijjo n’obwesige obusingawo nti: “Mukama! Mbeera mu Ggwe; ndibala ebibala bingi. Obunafu bwange ge maanyi gange. Kibe bwe kityo. Awatali Ggwe, tewali kintu. Mu Ggwe, ebibala bingi.”

Awatali Nze — mmwe temuli kintu. Mukama, nzikiriza n’essanyu enteekateeka eno: nze siri kintu — Ggwe byonna. Obutaba kintu kwange gwe mukisa gwange ogusinga obunene, kubanga Ggwe Muzabbibu, agaba era akola byonna. Kibe bwe kityo, Mukama! Nze, siri kintu, nga ndindirira obujjuvu bwo bulijjo. Mukama, mbikkulira ekitiibwa ky’obulamu buno obw’omukisa.

Tunuulira nate ettabi eryo ettono, eritaliiko kye lyesobolera era eritabala bibala wabula nga lifuna amasanda okuva mu muzabbibu, oyige nti okukakasa okujjuvu nti toyinza kukola kintu kyonna awatali Kristo kye kyennyini ky’oyetaaga okukuyigiriza okubeera mu Muzabbibu wo ow’omu ggulu. Ago ge makulu amakulu ag’okulongoosa Kristo kwe yayogerako — byonna ebyaffe ku bwaffe biteekwa okussibwa wansi, obwesige bwaffe bubeere mu Kristo yekka. “Mubeere mu Nze” — ebibala bingi! “Awatali Nze” — tewali kintu! Waliwo okubuusabuusa kwonna ku kye tunaalonda? Ekyokuyiga ekimu eky’olugero luno kiri nti — nga bwe kiri ekikakafu era eky’obutonde ettabi okubeera mu muzabbibu, naawe oyinza okubeera mu Kristo. Kyeyava aba Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima; Katonda kyeyava aba Omulimi; kyewava oba ettabi. Tetwandikaabidde Katonda atununule emirembe gyonna okuva mu “awatali Nze,” era afuule “mubeere mu Nze” ekintu ekiriwo obutasalako? Omutima gwo gugende eri ekyo Kristo ky’ali, n’ekyo ky’ayinza okukola, eri obuyinza bwe obw’obwakatonda n’okwagala kwe okw’ekisa eri buli limu ku matabi ge, era olyogera bulijjo n’obwesige obusingawo nti: “Mukama! Mbeera mu Ggwe; ndibala ebibala bingi. Obunafu bwange ge maanyi gange. Kibe bwe kityo. Awatali Ggwe, tewali kintu. Mu Ggwe, ebibala bingi.” Awatali Nze — mmwe temuli kintu. Mukama, nzikiriza n’essanyu enteekateeka eno: nze siri kintu — Ggwe byonna. Obutaba kintu kwange gwe mukisa gwange ogusinga obunene, kubanga Ggwe Muzabbibu, agaba era akola byonna. Kibe bwe kityo, Mukama! Nze, siri kintu, nga ndindirira obujjuvu bwo bulijjo. Mukama, mbikkulira ekitiibwa ky’obulamu buno obw’omukisa.

fields.title: Amatabi Amakaze
fields.body_html:
Omuntu bw’atabeera mu nze asuulibwa ebweru ng’ettabi erikaze. Amatabi ng’ago bagakuŋŋaanya ne bagasuula ku muliro ne gaggya—Yokaana 15:6

Ebyokuyiga ebigambo bino bye bituyigiriza byangu nnyo era bikulu nnyo. Omuntu ayinza okutuuka ku nkolagana ne Kristo eyenkana awo n’alowooza nti ali mu Ye, naye n’asobola okusuulibwa ebweru. Waliwo ekintu ng’obutabeera mu Kristo, ekitwala omuntu mu kukala n’okwokebwa. Waliwo ekintu ng’ettabi erikaze — omuntu oyo kirabika nti yegatta ne Kristo ku ntandikwa, naye ne kirabika nti okukkiriza kwe kwali kwa kaseera buseera. Nga kino kye kiyita ekikulu okutunula okwetooloola tulabe oba nga temuli matabi makaze mu makanisa gaffe, n’okwetunuulira munda tulabe oba ddala tubeera mu Ye era tubala ebibala!

Era kiki ekiyinza okuba ensonga y’“obutabeera” kuno? Abamu tebaategeera ngeri okuyitibwa kw’Omukristaayo gye kutwala omuntu mu kugondera okutukuvu n’okuweereza mu kwagala. Baamatira n’ekirowoozo nti baakkiriza, era nti baali bawonye Ggeyeena; tebaalina kibakubiriza wadde amaanyi ag’okubeera mu Kristo — tebaamanya nti kyetaagisa. Abalala okweraliikirira kw’ebintu by’ensi, oba obugagga bwayo, ne bibuutikira ekigambo: tebaali balese byonna okugoberera Kristo. Abalala nate eddiini yaabwe n’okukkiriza kwabwe byali mu magezi ga bantu, so si mu maanyi ga Katonda. Beesiga engeri z’okufuna ekisa, oba obwesimbu bwabwe, oba obutereevu bw’okukkiriza kwabwe mu kisa ekituweesa obutuukirivu; tebaatuuka wadde ku kunoonya okubeera mu Kristo mu bujjuvu ng’obukuumi bwabwe bwokka. Tekyewuunyisa nti empewo ey’ebbugumu ey’okukemebwa oba okuyigganyizibwa bwe yakunta, ne bawotoka: tebaali basimbye mirandira mu Kristo ddala.

Tuzibule amaaso gaffe tulabe oba nga temuli matabi makaze wonna okutwetooloola mu makanisa. Abavubuka, abaayatula okukkiriza kwabwe mu kitangaala, naye kaakano nga bagenda banyogoga. Oba abakadde, abaakuuma okwatula kwabwe, naye obulamu obwali bulabika mu bo bwazikira. Abaweereza n’abakkiriza bakwate ebigambo bya Kristo ku mutima, balabe, era babuuze Mukama oba nga tewali kiyinza kukolebwa olw’amatabi agatandise okukala. Era ekigambo Mubeere kivuge mu Kkanisa yonna okutuusa buli mukkiriza lw’alikikwata — tewali bukuumi wabula mu kubeera mu Kristo okw’amazima.

Buli omu ku ffe yeetunuulire munda. Obulamu bwaffe bubisi, bwa kiragala, era bwa maanyi, nga bubala ebibala byabwo mu ntuuko zaabyo? (Laba Zabbuli 1:3; 92:13, 14; Yeremiya 17:7, 8.) Tukkirize buli kulabula n’omwoyo ogwagala, era ebigambo bya Kristo “Omuntu bw’atabeera mu nze” biwe ebigambo bye “mubeere mu Nze” obwangu obuggya. Eri omwoyo omwesimbu, ekyama ky’okubeera mu Ye kijja kweyongera okuba ekyangu: kwe kumanya bumanya ekifo Ye mw’anteeka; kwe kuwummula ng’omwana mu kwegatta kwange naye, n’obwesige nti Ye alinkuuma. Ayi, tukkirize nti waliwo obulamu obutamanyi kukala, obubeera obubisi bulijjo; era obubala ebibala bingi!

Erikaze! Ayi Kitange, ntunuulira, onkuume, era tokkiriza kintu kyonna kiziyize wadde akaseera akatono obubisi obuva mu kubeera mu Muzabbibu mu bujjuvu. Ekirowoozo kyokka eky’ettabi erikaze kinjjuze okutya okutukuvu n’okutunula.

fields.title: Buli Kye Munaasabanga
fields.body_html:
Bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga—Yokaana 15:7

Ekifo kyonna eky’ettabi mu muzabbibu kya kusaba obutasalako. Awatali kuwummula liba likoowoola bulijjo nti: “Ayi muzabbibu wange, weereza amasanda ge nneetaaga okubala ebibala byo.” Era okusaba kwalyo tekulema kuddibwamu: lisaba kye lyetaaga, kye liyagala, era kikolebwa.

Obulamu obulungi obw’omukkiriza mu Kristo nabwo bwe butyo bwa kusaba obutasalako. Ng’amanyi oba nga tamanyi, abeera mu kwesigama okutasalako. Ekigambo kya Mukama we, “temuliiko kye muyinza kukola,” kimuyigirizza nti okusaba kwe n’okufuna kwe biteekwa okuba ebitasalako ng’ettabi bwe litasalako kubeera mu muzabbibu. Ekisuubizo ky’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kituwa obuvumu obutaliiko kkomo: “buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga.”

Ekisuubizo kino kiweereddwa nga kikwatagana butereevu n’okubala ebibala. Bw’okikugira ku ggwe wekka n’ebyetaago byo, okiggyako amaanyi gaakyo; weggyako amaanyi ag’okukyefunira. Kristo yali atuma abayigirizwa bano, era baali beetegese okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe olw’ensi; bo yabakwasa obuyinza ku by’obugagga by’omu Ggulu. Okusaba kwabwe kwandireese Omwoyo n’amaanyi ge baali beetaaga olw’omulimu gwabwe.

Ekisuubizo kino kiweereddwa nga kikwatagana butereevu n’okujja kw’Omwoyo. Omwoyo tayogerwako mu lugero, nga n’amasanda g’omuzabbibu bwe gatayogerwako. Naye byombi bitegeezebwa okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Mu ssuula esooka olugero, Mukama waffe yali ayogedde ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu ng’akwatagana n’obulamu bwabwe obw’omunda: ng’abeera mu bo, era nga yeebikkula munda mu bo (14:15-23). Mu ssuula eddako ayogera ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu ng’akwatagana n’omulimu gwabwe: ng’ajja gye bali, ng’alumiriza ensi, era ng’agulumiza Yesu (16:7-14). Okusobola okweyambisa ebisuubizo by’okusaba ebitaliiko kkomo, tuteekwa okuba abantu abajjudde Omwoyo, era abeewaddeyo ddala eri omulimu n’ekitiibwa kya Yesu. Omwoyo alitukulembera mu mazima g’amakulu gaakyo n’obukakafu bw’okutuukirizibwa kwakyo.

Tutegeere nti tuyinza kutuukiriza kuyitibwa kwaffe okubala ebibala bingi nga tusaba nnyo. Mu Kristo mwe mukwekeddwa eby’obugagga byonna abantu abatwetoolodde bye beetaaga; mu Ye abaana ba Katonda bonna baweereddwa buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo; ajjudde ekisa n’amazima. Naye kyetaagisa okusaba, okusaba okungi, okusaba okw’amaanyi okw’okukkiriza, okuleeta emikisa gino wansi. Era tujjukire n’ekyo nti tetuyinza kwefunira kisuubizo kino awatali bulamu obwewaddeyo olw’abantu. Bangi bagezaako okutwala ekisuubizo, oluvannyuma ne beetunuulira okulaba kye bayinza okusaba. Eyo si ye ngeri; wabula ekikontana nayo ddala. Omutima gwo gujjule omugugu gw’obwetaavu bw’emyoyo, n’ekiragiro eky’okugirokola, era amaanyi ag’okubanja ekisuubizo gajja kujja.

Tukibanje ng’ekimu ku bibikkulirwa eby’obulamu bwaffe obw’ekitalo mu Muzabbibu: atugamba nti bwe tusaba mu linnya lye, olw’okwegatta kwaffe naye, buli kye tunaasaba, kinaatukolerwa. Emyoyo gizikirira kubanga okusaba kutono nnyo. Abaana ba Katonda banafu kubanga okusaba kutono nnyo. Tubala ebibala bitono nnyo kubanga okusaba kutono nnyo. Okukkiriza ekisuubizo kino kwandituwadde amaanyi okusaba; tuleme kuwummula okutuusa nga kiyingidde mu mutima gwaffe ddala, ne kitusika mu maanyi ga Kristo okunyiikira, okutegana n’okulwana mu kusaba okutuusa omukisa lwe gunaajja n’amaanyi. Okuba ettabi tekitegeeza kubala bibala ku nsi kyokka, wabula n’amaanyi mu kusaba okuleeta omukisa okuva mu Ggulu. Okubeera mu Ye mu bujjuvu kitegeeza kusaba nnyo.

Buli kye munaasabanga. Ayi Mukama wange, lwaki emitima gyaffe gisobola kitono nnyo okukkiriza ebigambo bino mu bwangu bwabyo obw’obwakatonda? Ayi, mpa okulaba nti tetwetaaga kitono ku kisuubizo kino okuwangula obuyinza bw’ensi ne Setaani! Tuyigirize okusaba mu kukkiriza ekisuubizo kyo kino.

fields.title: Bwe Munywerera mu Nze
fields.body_html:
Bwe munywerera mu Nze ne munyweza ebigambo byange, buli kye munaasabanga kinaabakolerwanga—Yokaana 15:7

Ensonga lwaki omuzabbibu n’amatabi gaagwo lugero lwa mazima ddala olw’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo eri nti obutonde bwonna bulina ensibuko emu era bulimu omwoyo gumu. Ebimera byatondebwa okubeera eri omuntu ekyokulabirako ekimuyigiriza nti yeesigama ku Katonda mu byonna, era nti mu kwesigama okwo mw’alina obukuumi. Oyo ayambaza ebimuli by’omu nsiko, alisinga nnyo okutwambaza ffe. Oyo awa emiti n’emizabbibu obulungi bwagyo n’ebibala byagyo, ng’afuula buli gumu ekyo kye yagutegekera okubeera, alisinga nnyo okutufuula ekyo ky’ayagala tubeere. Enjawulo eri emu yokka: Katonda by’akola mu miti abikola n’amaanyi gye gitamanyi. Mu ffe ayagala okukola nga ffe tukkirizza. Kino kye kitiibwa ky’omuntu: alina okwesalirawo okuyinza okukolera awamu ne Katonda, ng’ategeera, ng’asiima era ng’akkiriza ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala okumukolera.

Bwe munywerera—Wano we wali enjawulo wakati w’ettabi ly’omuzabbibu ogw’omu nnimiro n’ettabi ly’Omuzabbibu ogw’omwoyo. Erisooka libeera ku muzabbibu lwa maanyi ga butonde; ery’okubiri libeera mu Gwo, si lwa maanyi ga kwesalirawo, wabula lwa maanyi ga Katonda agaweebwa omutima ogukkiriza. Katonda bw’atyo bw’ateeseteese mu ngeri ey’ekitalo: amaanyi g’obutonde bye gakola ku ttabi erimu, amaanyi g’ekisa ge galikikola ku ddala. Ettabi lisobola okubeera mu Muzabbibu.

Bwe munywerera mu Nze...buli kye munaasabanga—Bwe tuba ab’okubeera n’obulamu obw’okusaba obw’amazima, nga bulimu okwagala, amaanyi n’obumanyirivu bw’okusaba, tewalina kubaawo kubuusabuusa kwonna ku kubeera mu Kristo. Era bwe tubeera mu Ye, tewali kubuusabuusa ku ddembe lyaffe okusaba kye twagala, ne ku bukakafu nti kinaatukolerwa. Waliwo akakwakkulizo kamu: “Bwe munywerera mu Nze.” Tewalina kubaawo kulonzalonza ku ngeri gye kisoboka oba ku bukakafu bwakyo. Tulina okwekaliriza ettabi eryo ettono n’amaanyi galyo ag’ekitalo ag’okubala ebibala ebirungi bwe bityo, okutuusa lwe tunaayiga ddala okubeera mu Kristo.

Kale ekyama kyakwo kye kiruwa? Weemalire ku Yesu. Simba emirandira gy’obulamu bwo wansi ddala mu Ye olw’okukkiriza, okwagala n’obuwulize. Va mu buli kifo ekirala, ojje obeere wano.
