fields.title: Kitange Agulumizibwa
fields.body_html:
Bwe mubala ebibala ebingi, … ne Kitange, agulumizibwa—Yokaana 15:8

Tuyinza tutya okugulumiza Katonda? Si lwa kwongera ku kitiibwa kye wadde okumuleetera ekitiibwa ekipya ky’atalina. Wabula lwa kuganya buganya kitiibwa kye okwakaayakana nga kiyita mu ffe, olw’okwewaayo gy’ali, ekitiibwa kye kyeyolese mu ffe era kiyite mu ffe okutuuka eri ensi. Ennimiro y’emizabbibu oba omuzabbibu ogubala ebibala ebingi bigulumiza nannyini gwo, kubanga byoleka obukugu bwe n’obwegendereza bwe. Mu muyigirizwa abala ebibala ebingi, Kitaffe agulumizibwa. Mu maaso g’abantu ne bamalayika, wabaawo obujulizi obw’ekitiibwa ky’ekisa kya Katonda n’amaanyi ge; ekitiibwa kya Katonda kyakaayakana nga kiyita mu ye.

Kino Peetero ky’agamba bw’awandiika nti: “Ayamba, akikolenga n’amaanyi gonna Katonda g’amuwadde; mu byonna Katonda alyoke agulumizibwenga mu Yesu Kristo.” Omuntu bw’akola era n’aweereza mu maanyi agava eri Katonda yekka, Katonda y’afuna ekitiibwa kyonna. Bwe twatula nti amaanyi gaava eri Katonda yekka, oyo akola omulimu n’abo abagulaba bonna bagulumiza Katonda. Katonda ye yakikola. Abantu bategeerera ku bibala by’ennimiro omulimi waayo bw’ali. Abantu bategeerera Katonda ku bibala amatabi g’Omuzabbibu gwe yasimba bye gabala. Ebibala ebitono bireetera Katonda ekitiibwa kitono. Tebiweesa kitiibwa Muzabbibu wadde Omulimi. “Bwe mubala ebibala ebingi, … ne Kitange, agulumizibwa.”

Oluusi tukaabidde obutabala bibala kwaffe, nga tukutwala ng’okufiirwa eri ffe ne bantu bannaffe, ne twemulugunya nti obunafu bwaffe bwe buvuddeko. Naye ka tulowooze nnyo ku kibi n’ensonyi ez’ebibala ebitono, kubanga binyaga Katonda ekitiibwa kye yandifunye okuva gye tuli. Ka tuyige ekyama ky’okuleetera Katonda ekitiibwa, nga tuweereza n’amaanyi Katonda g’atuwa. Okukkiriza ddala ekigambo kya Kristo nti, “temuliiko kye muyinza kukola”; okukkiriza okwangu mu Katonda akola byonna mu byonna; okubeera mu Kristo, Omulimi ow’obwakatonda mw’ayita okukola omulimu gwe n’afuna ebibala ebingi—buno bwe bulamu obuliweesa Katonda ekitiibwa.

Ebibala ebingi—Katonda abisaba; kakasa nti obimuwa. Katonda tayinza kumatira na kitono ku ebyo; naawe tomatiranga na kitono ku ebyo. Ebigambo bino ebya Kristo—ebibala, ebibala ebisingawo, ebibala ebingi—bibeere mu ggwe, okutuusa lw’onoolowooza nga bw’alowooza, n’oba mwetegefu okutoola gy’ali, Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu, ekyo ky’akutegekedde. Ebibala ebingi, ne Kitange, agulumizibwa. Obunene bw’ekyo ky’asaba bubeere ekikuzzaamu amaanyi. Kisukkiridde nnyo amaanyi go, ne kikusindika okwesigama ddala ku Kristo, Omuzabbibu gwo ogw’amazima. Ye asobola, era ajja, okukituukiriza mu ggwe.

Ebibala ebingi—Katonda abisaba kubanga abyetaaga. Tasaba bibala okuva ku matabi g’Omuzabbibu gwe lwa kwolesa bwolesa, okulaga ky’ayinza okukola. Nedda; abyetaaga olw’obulokozi bw’abantu: omwo mw’agulumizibwa. Weesuule ku Muzabbibu gwo ne ku Mulimi wo ng’osaba nnyo. Kaabirira Katonda Kitaawo akuwe ebibala by’oneetwalira abantu. Weetikke omugugu gw’abalumwa enjala n’abazikirira, nga Yesu bwe yakola bwe yabasaasira, era amaanyi go mu kusaba, n’okubeera kwo mu Kristo, n’okubala kwo ebibala ebingi olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe, bijja kubaamu amazima n’obukakafu bye wali tonnamanya.

Kitange, agulumizibwa. Ekisuubirwa eky’omukisa—Katonda yeegulumiza mu nze, ng’alaga ekitiibwa ky’obulungi bwe n’amaanyi ge mu ebyo by’akola mu nze ne mu ebyo by’ayisa mu nze. Nga kino kye kinsikiriza okubala ebibala ebingi, nga bw’akola mu nze! Kitaffe, weegulumize mu nze.

fields.title: Abayigirizwa ab’Amazima
fields.body_html:
Bwe mubala ebibala ebingi, muba bayigirizwa bange, ne Kitange, agulumizibwa—Yokaana 15:8

Kale abo abatabala bibala bingi si bayigirizwa? Bayinza okuba bo, naye nga bakyali mabega era nga tebannakula. Ku abo ababala ebibala ebingi, Kristo agamba nti: “Bano be bayigirizwa bange, nga bwe njagala babeere—bano be bayigirizwa ab’amazima.” Nga bwe tugamba ku muntu alimu ddala ekifaananyi ky’obusajja nti: Oyo ye musajja! Bw’atyo Mukama waffe bw’alaga abayigirizwa abali ng’omutima gwe bwe guyagala, abasaanira erinnya eryo: abo ababala ebibala ebingi. Mu Njiri tusangamu amakulu gano abiri ag’ekigambo omuyigirizwa. Oluusi kikozesebwa ku bonna abakkiriza okuyigiriza kwa Kristo. Ebiseera ebirala kitwaliramu ekibinja eky’omunda kyokka eky’abo abaagoberera Kristo n’omutima gwabwe gwonna, ne beewaayo gy’ali abatendeke olw’okuweereza. Enjawulo eno ebaddewo mu mirembe gyonna. Bulijjo wabaddewo omuwendo omutono ogw’abantu ba Katonda abaafuba okumuweereza n’omutima gwabwe gwonna, so ng’ate abasinga obungi bamatidde n’okumanya okutono ennyo ku kisa kye ne ku by’ayagala.

Kale enjawulo eri ki wakati w’ekibinja kino eky’omunda ekitono n’abangi abatafuba kukiyingiramu? Tugisanga mu bigambo bino: ebibala ebingi. Eri Abakristaayo bangi, ekirowoozo ky’obukuumi bwabwe bokka, ekyali ekituufu bwe baasooka okuzuukusibwa, kisigala okutuusa ku nkomerero nga kye kigendererwa kyokka eky’eddiini yaabwe. Ekirowoozo ky’okuweereza n’eky’ebibala bulijjo kiba kya kubiri era kitono nnyo. Okwegomba okw’amazima okw’okubala ebibala ebingi tekubateganya. Emyoyo egiwulidde okuyitibwa okubeera abalamu olwa Mukama waabwe yekka, okuwaayo obulamu bwabwe ku lulwe nga bwe yawaayo obubwe ku lwabwe, tegiyinza kumatira na kino n’akatono. Okukaaba kwabwe kwe kubala ebibala bingi nga bwe kisoboka, ebingi nga Mukama waabwe bw’ayinza okubyagala oba okubibawa mu bo.

Bwe mubala ebibala ebingi, muba bayigirizwa bange—Nkwegayiridde, buli asoma afumiitirize nnyo ku bigambo bino. Tomatira na kirowoozo kya kukola mpolampola omulimu omusingako obungi oba obulungi. Mu ngeri eyo kiyinza obutatuuka n’akatono. Twala ebigambo bino, ebibala ebingi, ng’okubikkulirwa okuva eri Omuzabbibu gwo ogw’omu ggulu ku ekyo ky’olina okubeera, era ky’oyinza okubeera. Kkiriza ddala nti tekisoboka, era nti busirusiru bwennyini okukigezaako mu maanyi go. Ebigambo ebyo bikuyite otunuulire buggya Omuzabbibu, ogweyamye okulaga obujjuvu bwagwo obw’omu ggulu mu ggwe. Bizuukuse mu ggwe nate okukkiriza n’okwatula nti: “Ndi ttabi ly’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima; nsobola okubala ebibala ebingi olw’ekitiibwa kye, n’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe.”

Tetwetaaga kusalira balala misango. Naye mu Kigambo kya Katonda buli wamu tulabamu ebika by’abayigirizwa bibiri. Waleme kubaawo kulonzalonza ku wa we twetwala. Ka tumusabe atubikkulire nga bw’asaba era bw’ayagaliza ddala obulamu obwewaddeyo gy’ali bwonna, okujjula Omwoyo we nga bw’ayinza okutujjuza. Okwegomba kwaffe kuleme kuba kutono ku kulongoosebwa okutuukiridde, okubeera mu Ye okutaggwaawo, okussa ekimu naye okw’okumpi ennyo, n’okubala ebibala mu bungi—amatabi ag’amazima ag’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima.

Ensi ezikirira, ekkanisa eremererwa, omulimu gwa Kristo gubonaabona, Kristo anakuwala olw’obutabaawo Bakristaayo abeewaayo n’omutima gwabwe gwonna, ababala ebibala ebingi. Newaakubadde nga tolaba bulungi kye kitegeeza oba engeri gye kirijja, mugambe nti oli ttabi lye eribala ebibala ebingi; nti oli mwetegefu okubeera omuyigirizwa we mu makulu ge yennyini ag’ekigambo ekyo.

Bayigirizwa bange. Mukama Omutendereze, ebibala ebingi bwe bukakafu nti Ggwe Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima olina mu nze ettabi ery’amazima, omuyigirizwa eyeewaddeyo gy’oli ddala. Nkwegayiridde, mpa okumanya okw’omwana omuto nti ebibala byange bikusanyusa, era nti by’otwala ng’ebibala ebingi.

Bwe mubala ebibala ebingi, muba bayigirizwa bange—Nkwegayiridde, buli asoma afumiitirize nnyo ku bigambo bino. Tomatira na kirowoozo kya kukola mpolampola omulimu omusingako obungi oba obulungi. Mu ngeri eyo kiyinza obutatuuka n’akatono. Twala ebigambo bino, ebibala ebingi, ng’okubikkulirwa okuva eri Omuzabbibu gwo ogw’omu ggulu ku ekyo ky’olina okubeera, era ky’oyinza okubeera. Kkiriza ddala nti tekisoboka, era nti busirusiru bwennyini okukigezaako mu maanyi go. Ebigambo ebyo bikuyite otunuulire buggya Omuzabbibu, ogweyamye okulaga obujjuvu bwagwo obw’omu ggulu mu ggwe. Bizuukuse mu ggwe nate okukkiriza n’okwatula nti: “Ndi ttabi ly’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima; nsobola okubala ebibala ebingi olw’ekitiibwa kye, n’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe.” Tetwetaaga kusalira balala misango. Naye mu Kigambo kya Katonda buli wamu tulabamu ebika by’abayigirizwa bibiri. Waleme kubaawo kulonzalonza ku wa we twetwala. Ka tumusabe atubikkulire nga bw’asaba era bw’ayagaliza ddala obulamu obwewaddeyo gy’ali bwonna, okujjula Omwoyo we nga bw’ayinza okutujjuza. Okwegomba kwaffe kuleme kuba kutono ku kulongoosebwa okutuukiridde, okubeera mu Ye okutaggwaawo, okussa ekimu naye okw’okumpi ennyo, n’okubala ebibala mu bungi—amatabi ag’amazima ag’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima. Ensi ezikirira, ekkanisa eremererwa, omulimu gwa Kristo gubonaabona, Kristo anakuwala olw’obutabaawo Bakristaayo abeewaayo n’omutima gwabwe gwonna, ababala ebibala ebingi. Newaakubadde nga tolaba bulungi kye kitegeeza oba engeri gye kirijja, mugambe nti oli ttabi lye eribala ebibala ebingi; nti oli mwetegefu okubeera omuyigirizwa we mu makulu ge yennyini ag’ekigambo ekyo. Bayigirizwa bange. Mukama Omutendereze, ebibala ebingi bwe bukakafu nti Ggwe Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima olina mu nze ettabi ery’amazima, omuyigirizwa eyeewaddeyo gy’oli ddala. Nkwegayiridde, mpa okumanya okw’omwana omuto nti ebibala byange bikusanyusa, era nti by’otwala ng’ebibala ebingi.

fields.title: Okwagala Okw’ekitalo
fields.body_html:
Mbaagadde nga Kitange bw’anjagala—Yokaana 15:9

Wano Kristo aleka olulimi lw’olugero, n’ayogera mu lwatu ku Kitaffe. Olugero newaakubadde lwayinza okuyigiriza bingi, terwayinza kuyigiriza ssomo ly’okwagala. Byonna omuzabbibu by’ekolera ettabi, gubikola lwa kuwalirizibwa tteeka ly’obutonde: tegulina kwagala kulamu okw’omuntu ku muntu eri ettabi. Tuli mu kabi ak’okutunuulira Kristo ng’Omulokozi era omugabi wa buli kye twetaaga, eyalondebwa Katonda, gwe twakkiriza era gwe twesiga, naye nga tetutegeera bungi bwa kwagala okw’omuntu ku muntu Kristo kw’atwagalamu, era obulamu bwaffe mwe bwokka mwe buyinza okufuna essanyu lyabwo ery’amazima. Kristo ayagala okutulaga kino.

Kale akikola atya? Atuzza nate gy’ali yennyini, okutulaga obulamu bwe nga bwe bufaanana ddala n’obwaffe. Nga Kitaffe bwe yamwagala, bw’atyo naye bw’atwagala. Obulamu bwe ng’omuzabbibu ogwesigama ku Kitaffe bwali bulamu mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe; okwagala okwo kwe kwali amaanyi ge n’essanyu lye; mu maanyi g’okwagala okwo okw’obwakatonda okwamubeerako mwe yabeerera omulamu era mwe yafiira. Bwe tuba ab’okubeera abalamu nga Ye, ng’amatabi agafaanana ddala Omuzabbibu gwago, naffe tulina okugabana ku kino. Obulamu bwaffe bulina okussiza omukka n’okubeerera mu kwagala okw’omu ggulu, nga obubwe bwe bwali. Okwagala kwa Kitaffe kye kwali gy’ali, n’okwagala kwe kye kunaaba gye tuli. Okwagala okwo bwe kwamufuula Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, okwagala kwe kuyinza okutufuula amatabi ag’amazima. “Mbaagadde nga Kitange bw’anjagala.”

Nga Kitange bw’anjagala—Kale Kitaffe yamwagala atya? Okwegomba okutaliiko kkomo n’essanyu lya Katonda okuwa Omwana byonna bye yalina yennyini, okutwala Omwana mu kwenkanankana okutuukiridde naye, okubeera mu Mwana n’Omwana okubeera mu Ye—kuno kwe kwali okwagala kwa Katonda eri Kristo. Kyama kya kitiibwa kye tutayinza kufunira kifaananyi kyonna mu birowoozo; tusobola kuvuunama kwokka ne tusinza nga tugezaako okukirowoozaako. Era n’okwagala okw’engeri eyo, n’okwagala okwo kwennyini, Kristo yeegomba mu kwegomba okutaliiko kkomo n’essanyu okutuwa byonna by’ali era by’alina, okutufuula abagabana ku butonde bwe n’omukisa gwe, okubeera mu ffe era naffe tubeere mu Ye.

Kale kaakano, Kristo bw’atwagala n’okwagala okw’amaanyi bwe kutyo, okutaliiko kkomo era okw’obwakatonda, kiki ekikulemesa okuwangula buli kiziyiza ne kututwalira ddala? Okuddamu kwangu. Nga okwagala kwa Kitaffe eri Kristo bwe kuli, n’okwagala kwe gye tuli kyama kya bwakatonda, kya waggulu nnyo ffe okutegeera oba okutuukako olw’okufuba kwaffe ffekka. Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka y’ayinza okufuka n’okubikkula, mu maanyi gaakwo agawangula byonna, awatali kuwummula, okwagala kuno okw’ekitalo okwa Katonda mu Kristo. Muzabbibu gwennyini gwe gulina okuwa ettabi okukula kwalyo n’ebibala byalyo nga gusindika amazzi gaagwo waggulu. Kristo yennyini y’alina okubeera mu mutima olw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu; olwo tulimanya era tulibeera n’okwagala kwa Kristo okusukkiridde okutegeera kwonna mu ffe.

Mbaagadde nga Kitange bw’anjagala—Kale tetusembere kumpi ne Kristo omulamu, ow’omuntu ku muntu, ne tumwesiga, ne tumuwa byonna, alyoke ayingize okwagala kuno mu ffe? Nga bwe yamanya era n’asanyuka buli ssaawa—Kitange anjagala—naffe tuyinza okubeera abalamu nga tumanyi bulijjo nti—nga Kitaffe bwe yamwagala, bw’atyo naye bw’anjagala.

Mbaagadde nga Kitange bw’anjagala. Mukama omwagalwa, kaakano kwe ntandika okutegeera nga obulamu bw’Omuzabbibu bwe bulina okubeera obw’ettabi nalyo ddala. Ggwe Muzabbibu, kubanga Kitaffe yakwagala, n’ayisa okwagala kwe mu Ggwe. Era bw’otyo naawe bw’onjagala, n’obulamu bwange ng’ettabi bulina okufaanana n’obubwo: okufuna n’okugaba okwagala okw’omu ggulu.

fields.title: Munywererenga mu Kwagala Kwange
fields.body_html:
Mbaagadde nga Kitange bw’anjagala. Noolwekyo munywererenga mu kwagala kwange—Yokaana 15:9

Noolwekyo munywererenga mu kwagala kwange—Bwe twogera ku maka g’omuntu, tugamba nti kye kifo ky’abeeramu. Ekifo kyaffe gye tubeera, amaka g’emmeeme yaffe, kirina kuba okwagala kwa Kristo. Eyo gye tulina okuwangaalira obulamu bwaffe, eyo gye tulina okuwulira nga tuli waka olunaku lwonna: kino Kristo ky’ayagala obulamu bwaffe bubeere, era ddala asobola okubufuula bwe butyo. Okubeera kwaffe mu Muzabbibu okutasalako kulina kuba kubeera mu kwagala kwe.

Oboolyawo wali owuliddeko oba osomye ku ekyo ekiyitibwa obulamu obw’omutendera ogwa waggulu, oba obulamu obw’omunda ennyo, obulamu obugagga oba obujjuvu, obulamu obusukkiridde. Era oboolyawo omanyi nti abamu boogedde ku nkyukakyuka ey’ekitalo, eyafuula obulamu bwabwe obw’okulemererwa n’okwesittala buli kiseera ne bufuuka obulamu obw’omukisa ennyo obw’okukuumibwa, okunywezebwa n’okusanyuka okusukkiridde. Singa obabuuza omukisa guno omunene bwe gwabajjira, bangi bandikugambye nti kyali kino kyokka: baatuusibwa okukkiriza nti okubeera kuno mu kwagala kwa Kristo kwategekebwa okuba okwa ddala, ne bafuulibwa abeetegefu okulekawo buli kintu ku lwakwo, ne balyoka basobozesebwa okwesiga Kristo okukibatuukiririzaamu.

Okwagala kwa Kitaffe eri Omwana si kuwulira bulyo—bwe bulamu obw’obwakatonda, amaanyi agatakoma, obuyinza obutaziyizika. Kwe kwatwala Kristo okuyita mu bulamu ne mu kufa ne mu ntaana. Kitaffe yamwagala, n’abeera mu Ye, n’amukolera byonna. Bwe kityo n’okwagala kwa Kristo gye tuli kwe maanyi amalamu agatakoma, agajja okukola mu ffe byonna by’asanyukira okutuwa. Obunafu bw’obulamu bwaffe obw’Ekikristaayo buva ku kuba nti tetwewa budde kukkiriza nti okwagala kuno okw’obwakatonda ddala kutusanyukira, era nti kujja kututwala ne kukola byonna mu ffe. Tetwewa budde kutunuulira Muzabbibu nga gusitula ettabi ddala, nga gukola byonna mu lyo mu bujjuvu. Tufuba okwekolera ffekka ekyo Kristo yekka ky’asobola, ekyo Kristo—ai, n’okwagala okungi bwe kutyo—ky’ayaayaanira okutukolera.

Era kino kaakano kye kyama ky’enkyukakyuka gye twogeddeko, era y’entandikwa y’obulamu obuggya: emmeeme bw’eraba okwagala kuno okutakoma nga kwetegefu okukola byonna, n’eyeewaayo gye kuli. “Noolwekyo munywererenga mu kwagala kwange.” Okukkiriza nti kisoboka okubeera bwe tutyo buli kaseera; okukkiriza nti buli ekikifuula ekizibu oba ekitasoboka Kristo yennyini ajja kukiwangula; okukkiriza nti Okwagala ddala kitegeeza okwegomba okutakoma okwewaayo gye tuli kwonna n’obutatuleka n’akatono; era mu kukkiriza kuno okwesuula ku Kristo akikole mu ffe; kino kye kyama ky’obulamu obw’amazima obw’Ekikristaayo.

Kale okukkiriza kuno tukutuukako tutya? Kyuka oveeko ku birabika bw’oba oyagala okulaba n’okufuna ebitalabika. Weewe ebiseera ebisingawo ne Yesu, ng’omutunuulira nga Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu, abeera mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe, ayagala naawe obeere mu kwagala kwe. Kyuka oveeko ku ggwe kennyini, ku kufuba kwo ne ku kukkiriza kwo, bw’oba oyagala omutima gujjule Ye n’obukakafu bw’okwagala kwe. Okubeera kitegeeza okuva ku bintu ebirala byonna, okutwala ekifo kimu n’osigala omwo. Va ku birala byonna, oteeke omutima gwo ku Yesu ne ku kwagala kwe; okwagala okwo kujja kuzuukusa okukkiriza kwo era kukunyweze. Weemalire ku kwagala okwo, kusinze, kulindirire. Oyinza okuba omukakafu nti kujja kukugololera omukono, era olw’amaanyi gaakwo kukuyingize mu kwo, kubeere ekifo ky’obeeramu era amaka go.

Noolwekyo munywererenga mu kwagala kwange. Mukama Yesu, ndaba nti kwali kubeera kwo mu kwagala kwa Kitaawo okwakufuula Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, ng’olina obujjuvu bwo obw’obwakatonda obw’okwagala n’omukisa ku lwaffe. Ai, nange nga ttabi, nsobole okubeera mu kwagala kwo bwe ntyo, obujjuvu bwakwo bunzijuze era bubooge ku bonna abanneetoolodde.

fields.title: Gondera era Obeere
fields.body_html:
Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange—Yokaana 15:10

Mu kufumiitiriza kwaffe okuwedde twayogera ku kuyingira mu bulamu obw’ekiwummulo n’amaanyi, okutera okujja omuntu bw’ategeera ddala okwagala kwa Kristo gy’ali ye kennyini, n’afuna obukakafu nti okwagala okwo ddala kutegeeza nti Ye ajja kukuuma emmeeme. Ku nkyukakyuka eyo, n’okukkiriza okugiraba ne kugikkiriza, ekigambo okwewaayo oba okweyawula eri Katonda kitera okukozesebwa. Emmeeme eraba nti teyinza kwetwalira kukuumibwa kw’okwagala kuno okw’ekitalo okuggyako nga yeewaddeyo mu bulamu obw’obuwulize obujjuvu. Abo ababeera mu Ye be abikkulira ekyama ky’okubeera mu kwagala kwe mu bujjuvu. Kwe kwewaayo n’omutima gwonna mu buli kintu okukola by’ayagala okuggulawo ekkubo eriyingira mu bulamu obw’okunyumirwa okwagala kwe obutasalako.

Mukama ow’ekisa, njigiriza essomo lino, nti omuntu ayinza okumanya omutima gwo ng’ayita mu kumanya by’oyagala kyokka, era ayinza okubeera mu kwagala kwo ng’ayita mu kukola by’oyagala ebyo kyokka. Mukama, njigiriza nti ng’okukola mu maanyi gange bwe kutaliiko mugaso, bwe kityo okukola okw’okukkiriza mu maanyi go kwa nkizo nnyo era tekwewalika, bwe mba nga njagala okubeera mu kwagala kwo.

fields.title: Nammwe, nga Nze
fields.body_html:
Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange, nga nange bwe ŋŋondera ebiragiro bya Kitange ne mbeera mu kwagala kwe—Yokaana 15:10

Emirundi egisoba mu gumu tufunye omukisa okwogera ku kufaanagana okutuukiridde okw’omuzabbibu n’ettabi mu butonde, era bwe kityo ne mu kigendererwa. Wano Kristo takyayogera mu lugero, naye atugamba lwatu engeri obulamu bwe yennyini gye buli ekyokulabirako ekituufu ddala eky’obulamu bwaffe. Yali agambye nti mu buwulize bwokka mwe tuyinza okubeera mu kwagala kwe. Kaakano atugamba nti eryo lye kkubo lye yabeereramu mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe. Ng’omuzabbibu bwe guli, n’ettabi bwe liri. Obulamu bwe, amaanyi ge n’essanyu lye byali mu kwagala kwa Kitaffe: mu buwulize bwokka mwe yabeerera omwo. Tuyinza okufuna obulamu bwaffe, amaanyi gaffe n’essanyu lyaffe mu kwagala kwe olunaku lwonna, naye mu buwulize obulinga obubwe bwokka mwe tuyinza okubeerera omwo. Okufaanana Omuzabbibu mu bujjuvu lye limu ku masomo ag’omuwendo ennyo ag’ettabi. Mu buwulize Kristo nga Muzabbibu mwe yassizaamu Kitaffe ekitiibwa nga Mulimi; mu buwulize omukkiriza nga ttabi mw’assizaamu Kristo ekitiibwa nga Muzabbibu.

Gondera era obeere—Eryo lye lyali etteeka ly’obulamu bwa Kristo, nga bwe lirina okuba ery’obulamu bwaffe. Yafaananyizibwa ffe mu byonna, ffe tulyoke tumufaanane mu byonna. Yaggulawo ekkubo mwe tuyinza okutambulira nga naye bwe yatambula. Yeetwalira obuntu bwaffe atuyigirize engeri y’okububeeramu, n’atulaga nti obuwulize, nga bwe buli omulimu ogusooka ogw’ekitonde, lye kkubo lyokka ery’okubeera mu kisa kya Katonda n’okuyingira mu kitiibwa kye. Era kaakano ajja okutuyigiriza n’okutuzzaamu amaanyi, n’atusaba okugondera ebiragiro bye, nga naye bwe yagondera ebiragiro bya Kitaawe era bw’abeera mu kwagala kwe.

Okusaanira okw’obwakatonda okw’akakwate kano wakati w’okugonda n’okubeera, wakati w’ebiragiro bya Katonda n’okwagala kwe, kulabika mangu. By’ayagala Katonda bye biri wakati ddala mu kutuukirira kwe okw’obwakatonda. Nga bwe byabikkulibwa mu biragiro bye, biggulawo ekkubo ekitonde kikule okufaanana Omutonzi. Mu kukkiriza n’okukola by’ayagala, nsituka ne ntuuka mu kussa ekimu naye. Kyeyava Omwana, bwe yali ajja mu nsi, n’agamba Katonda nti: “Nzize okukola by’oyagala”! Kino kye kyali ekifo era kino kye kyandibadde essanyu ly’ekitonde. Kino ekitonde kye kyafiirwa mu Kugwa. Kino Kristo kye yajjira okuzzaawo. Kino, nga Muzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu, ky’atusaba era ky’atuwa: nti nga naye bwe yabeera mu kwagala kwa Kitaawe ng’agondera ebiragiro bye, naffe tugonderenga ebiragiro bye era tubeere mu kwagala kwe.

Nammwe, nga Nze—Ettabi teriyinza kubala bibala okuggyako nga lirina obulamu bwe bumu ddala n’obw’Omuzabbibu. Obulamu bwaffe bulina okuba ekifaananyi ekituufu ddala eky’obulamu bwa Kristo. Busobola okuba bwe butyo, mu kigera kyennyini kye tumukkiririzaamu nga Muzabbibu, eyeewa yennyini n’obulamu bwe eri amatabi ge. “Nammwe, nga Nze,” bw’atyo Omuzabbibu bw’agamba: etteeka limu, obutonde bumu, ekibala kimu. Ka tuyige ddala okuva eri Mukama waffe essomo ly’obuwulize ng’ekyama ky’okubeera mu Ye. Ka twatule nti obuwulize obwangu, obutabuusabuusa, obwa buli kintu, tebuweereddwa kifo kye bwandibadde nakyo. Kristo yatufiirira nga tukyali balabe, bwe twali abajeemu. Yatutwala n’atuyingiza mu kwagala kwe; kaakano nga tuli mu Ye, Ekigambo kye kiri nti: “Gondera era obeere; nammwe, nga Nze.” Ka twewe okugonda n’omutima omwetegefu era ogw’okwagala. Ajja kutukuuma nga tubeera mu kwagala kwe.

Nammwe, nga Nze. Ai Muzabbibu wange omutendereze, afuula ettabi okugabana mu buli kintu ku bulamu bwo n’okufaanana kwo, ne mu kino nange nnina okukufaanana: ng’obulamu bwo bwe buli mu kwagala kwa Kitaawo olw’obuwulize, bwe butyo n’obwange bubeere mu kwagala kwo! Mulokozi, nnyamba, obuwulize bubeere ddala ekiyunga wakati wo nange.

fields.title: Essanyu
fields.body_html:
Mbategeezezza ebyo mulyoke mujjule essanyu lyange. Era essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire—Yokaana 15:11

Omuntu yenna bw’abuuza ekibuuzo nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuba Omukristaayo alina essanyu?” okuddamu kwa Mukama waffe kwangu nnyo: “Mbategeezezza ebyo,” ebikwata ku muzabbibu n’amatabi, “mulyoke mujjule essanyu lyange. Era essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire.” “Temuyinza kuba na ssanyu lyange awatali bulamu bwange. Mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe, n’essanyu lyange linaabanga mu mmwe.” Obulamu bwonna obulamu obulungi kintu kya ssanyu na bulungi; beeranga mu bulamu bw’ettabi awatali kwesalamu; ojja kuba n’essanyu lye mu kigera ekijjuvu.

Eri Abakristaayo bangi, ekirowoozo ky’obulamu obubeera mu Kristo ddala kirowoozo kya kwenyigiriza n’okufuba okw’obulumi. Tebasobola kulaba nti okwenyigiriza n’okufuba ebyo bijja kyokka nga tetunneewaayo awatali kwekomako eri obulamu bwa Kristo mu ffe. Ebigambo ebisooka ddala eby’olugero tebinnaba kubabikkulirwa: “Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima; neetikka byonna era ngaba byonna; ettabi sirina kye ndisaba okuggyako lyewe gye ndi ddala, era lindeke nkole byonna. Neeyama okufuula ettabi n’okulikuuma nga liri byonna bye lisaanidde okuba.” Tekisaanidde kubeera ssanyu eritakoma era eritasalako okulaba Omuzabbibu nga gukola byonna bwe gutyo, n’okumanya nti tewali mulala wabula Omwana wa Katonda omutendereze, mu kwagala kwe, y’atusitula buli kaseera era y’akuuma obulamu bwaffe?

Mulyoke mujjule essanyu lyange—Tulina okuba n’essanyu lya Kristo yennyini mu ffe. Era essanyu lya Kristo yennyini lye liruwa? Tewali ssanyu lifaanana kwagala. Tewali ssanyu wabula okwagala. Kristo yali yaakamala okwogera ku kwagala kwa Kitaffe n’okubeera kwe yennyini mu kwo, era ku ngeri gye yatwagalamu n’okwagala okwo kwennyini. Essanyu lye si kirala wabula essanyu ly’okwagala, ery’okwagalibwa n’ery’okwagala. Lyali ssanyu ery’okufuna okwagala kwa Kitaawe n’okubeera mu kwo, n’oluvannyuma essanyu ery’okugabira abalala okwagala okwo n’okukufukira ku boonoonyi. Essanyu lino ly’ayagala tugabaneko: essanyu ery’okwagalibwa Kitaffe ne Ye; essanyu ery’okwagala naffe n’okubeerawo ku lw’abo abatwetoolodde. Lino lye ssanyu ery’okuba amatabi ddala: okubeera mu kwagala kwe, n’oluvannyuma okwewaayo mu kwagala okubala ebibala ku lw’abalala. Ka tukkirize obulamu bwe, nga bw’abutuwa mu ffe nga ye Muzabbibu, essanyu lye lijja kuba lyaffe: essanyu ery’okubeera mu kwagala kwe, essanyu ery’okwagala nga Ye, ery’okwagala n’okwagala kwe.

Era essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire—Liryoke liwere, mulyoke mulijjule. Nga kya nnaku nti twetaaga nnyo okujjukizibwa nti, nga Katonda yekka bw’ali ensulo y’essanyu lyonna, “Katonda wange era essanyu lyange eritasingika,” ekkubo lyokka ery’okuba n’essanyu erituukiridde kwe kufuna ku Katonda, ku by’ayagala ne ku kussa ekimu naye, nga bwe kisoboka okusingawo! Eddiini egendereddwa okuba, mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku, ekintu eky’essanyu eritayogerekeka. Kale lwaki bangi beemulugunya nti si bwe kiri? Essanyu lyange—essanyu lyammwe. Ne mu kino bwe kiri: ng’omuzabbibu bwe guli, n’ettabi bwe liri; omuzabbibu gwonna mu ttabi. Essanyu lyo lye ssanyu lyaffe—essanyu lyo mu ffe, n’essanyu lyaffe nga lituukiridde. Mukama Omutendereze, nzijuza essanyu lyo—essanyu ery’okwagalibwa n’okuweebwa omukisa n’okwagala okw’obwakatonda; essanyu ery’okwagala abalala n’okubawa omukisa.

fields.title: Mwagalanenga
fields.body_html:
Kye mbalagira kye kino nti mwagalanenga—Yokaana 15:12

Katonda kwagala. Obutonde bwe bwonna n’okutuukirira kwe kwagala: tabeerawo ku lwe yekka, wabula okugaba obulamu n’emikisa. Mu kwagala kwe yazaala Omwana, alyoke amuwe byonna. Mu kwagala kwe yatonda ebitonde, alyoke abiwe omugabo ku mukisa gwe.

Kristo ye Mwana w’okwagala kwa Katonda; ye akwetikka, ye akubikkula, era ye akutuusa ku bantu. Obulamu bwe n’okufa kwe byonna byali kwagala. Okwagala bwe bulamu bwe, era bwe bulamu bw’agaba. Abeerawo lwa kwagala kwokka: okulamira obulamu bwe obw’okwagala mu ffe, n’okwewaayo yennyini mu bonna abanaamusembeza. Ekirowoozo ekisookera ddala eky’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima kwe kwagala—okubeerawo olw’okugabira amatabi obulamu bwe kwokka.

Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye Mwoyo ow’okwagala. Tayinza kugaba bulamu bwa Kristo nga tagabye na kwagala kwe. Obulokozi si kirala wabula okwagala okutuwangula ne kuyingira mu ffe; obulokozi bwe tulina bwenkana okwagala kwe tulina. Obulokozi obujjuvu kwe kwagala okutuukiridde.

Tekyewuunyisa nti Kristo yagamba nti: “Mbawa ekiragiro ekiggya”; “Kye mbalagira kye kino”—ekiragiro ekimu ekizingiramu byonna—“nti mwagalanenga.” Ettabi teriri limu na muzabbibu kyokka, wabula n’amatabi gaagwo amalala gonna; ganywa omwoyo gumu, gakola omubiri gumu, gabala ekibala kimu. Tewali kiyinza kuba kikontana na butonde okusinga Abakristaayo obutaagalananga nga Kristo bwe yabaagala. Obulamu bwe baafuna okuva mu Muzabbibu gwabwe ogw’omu ggulu si kirala wabula kwagala. Kino kye kintu ekimu ky’abasaba okusinga ebirala byonna. “Bwe munaayagalananga abantu bonna kwe banaategeereranga nti muli bayigirizwa bange.” Ng’engeri y’omuzabbibu bw’emanyibwa olw’ekibala kye gubala, n’obutonde bw’Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu businziirwako okusalirwa olw’okwagala abayigirizwa be kwe balina bokka na bokka.

Laba nga ogondera ekiragiro kino. “Okugonda n’okubeera” kwo kulabikire mu kino. Yagala baganda bo ng’ekkubo ery’okubeera mu kwagala kwa Mukama wo. Obweyamo bwo obw’okugonda butandikire wano. Mwagalanenga. Enkolagana yo n’Abakristaayo ab’omu maka go ebeere kwagala okutukuvu, okugonvu, okufaanana okwa Kristo. Ebirowoozo byo ku Bakristaayo abakwetoolodde bibeere, okusooka byonna, mu mwoyo gw’okwagala kwa Kristo. Obulamu bwo n’empisa zo bibeere ssaddaaka ey’okwagala—weewaayo okulowooza ku bibi byabwe oba ku bwetaavu bwabwe, okubeegayiririra, okubayamba n’okubaweereza. Mu kkanisa yo oba mu kibiina kyo, beera ekifaananyi ekirabika eky’okwagala kwa Kristo. Obulamu Kristo bw’alamira mu ggwe kwagala; n’obulamu mw’obulamira bubeere kwagala kwokka.

Naye, owange, owandiika ng’alinga bino byonna bya butonde, byangu era tebizibu. Kisoboka ddala okubeera bwe tutyo n’okwagala bwe tutyo? Okuddamu kwange kuli nti: Kristo akiragira: oteekwa okugonda. Kristo akitegeeza ddala: oteekwa okugonda, oba tosobola kubeera mu kwagala kwe.

Naye ngezezzaako ne nnemererwa. Sirabayo ssuubi lya kubeera nga Kristo. Ah! ekyo kiri bwe kityo kubanga tewakwata kigambo kisooka eky’olugero—“Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima,” ekitegeeza nti: nkuwa byonna by’oyetaaga ng’ettabi, nkuwa byonna Nze kennyini bye nnina. Nkwegayiridde, okumanya nti walemererwa edda n’obunafu bwo obwa kaakano bikugobe eri Omuzabbibu. Ye kwagala kwonna. Ayagala okugaba. Agaba kwagala. Ajja kukuyigiriza okwagala, nga Ye bwe yayagala.

Mwagalanenga. Mukama Yesu omwagalwa, Ggwe oli kwagala kwonna; obulamu bwe watuwa kwagala; ekiragiro kyo ekiggya, era akabonero k’obuyigirizwa bwo, kye kino: “Mwagalanenga.” Nkkiriza omulimu guno: n’okwagala kw’onjagalamu, era nange kwe nkwagalamu, nnaayagalanga baganda bange.

fields.title: Nga Nze bwe Mbaagala
fields.body_html:
Kye mbalagira kye kino nti mwagalanenga nga Nze bwe mbaagala—Yokaana 15:12

Guno gwe mulundi ogwokubiri Mukama waffe ng’akozesa ekigambo kino—Nga Nze. Omulundi ogwasooka kyali ku nkolagana ye ne Kitaffe: okukwata ebiragiro bye, n’okubeera mu kwagala kwe. Bwe tutyo naffe tuteekwa okukwata ebiragiro bya Kristo, n’okubeera mu kwagala kwe. Omulundi ogwokubiri ayogera ku nkolagana ye naffe ng’etteeka ly’okwagala kwaffe eri baganda baffe: “Mwagalanenga nga nze bwe mbaagala.” Mu mirundi gyombi, endowooza ye n’empisa ze bye biteekwa okuba etteeka ly’ezaffe. Gano ge mazima nate ge tumaze okukaatiriza emirundi egisukka mu gumu—okufaanagana okutuukiridde wakati w’Omuzabbibu n’ettabi.

Nga Nze—Naye si kya bwereere okulowooza nti tusobola okukwata ebiragiro bye, n’okwagala ab’oluganda, nga Ye bwe yakwata ebya Kitaffe, era nga bwe yatwagala? Era okugezaako okwo tekuteekwa kukoma mu kulemererwa n’okuggwaamu amaanyi? Awatali kubuusabuusa, bwe tunaanoonya okutuukiriza ekiragiro kino mu maanyi gaffe, oba nga tetutegedde bulungi mazima g’Omuzabbibu n’amatabi gaagwo. Naye bwe tutegeera nti “nga Nze” lye ssomo lyennyini eddene ery’olugero, olulimi olumu olutakyuka Omuzabbibu lw’ayogera eri ettabi, tujja kulaba nti tekiri ku kye tuwulira nga tusobola okutuukiriza, wabula ku Kristo ky’asobola okukola mu ffe. Ebiragiro bino ebya waggulu era ebitukuvu—“Gonda, nga Nze! Yagala, nga Nze”—bigendereddwa kututuusa ku kutegeera obunafu bwaffe, era okuyita mu ekyo, okutuzuukusa tulabe obwetaavu, n’obulungi, n’obumala bw’ebyo ebituteekeddwateekeddwa mu Muzabbibu. Tujja kutandika okuwulira Omuzabbibu ng’ayogera n’ettabi buli kaseera: “Nga Nze. Nga Nze: Obulamu bwange bwe bulamu bwo; era olina omugabo mu bujjuvu bwange bwonna; Omwoyo ali mu ggwe, n’ekibala ekiva mu ggwe, byonna bye bimu ddala nga bwe biri mu Nze. Totya, naye okukkiriza kwo kukwate buli “Nga Nze” ng’obukakafu obw’obwakatonda nti kubanga mbeera mu ggwe, oyinza era osobola okubeera nga Nze.”

Naye lwaki, obanga kino ddala kye kitegeeza ky’olugero, obanga bwe bulamu ddala ettabi bwe liyinza okubeeramu, lwaki batono nnyo ababufuna? Kubanga tebamanyi kyama kya mu ggulu eky’Omuzabbibu. Bamanyi bingi ku lugero n’amasomo gaalwo amalungi. Naye ekyama eky’omwoyo ekikusike eky’Omuzabbibu mu buyinza bwe obw’obwakatonda n’okubeera kwe okumpi, ng’abawanirira era ng’abawa bye beetaaga olunaku lwonna—kino tebakimanyi, kubanga tebalindiridde Mwoyo wa Katonda kukibabikkulira.

Mwagalanenga nga nze bwe mbaagala—“Mmwe, nga Nze.” Tunaatandika tutya obanga ddala tugenda kuyiga ekyama kino? Nga twatula nti twetaaga okuleetebwa mu ngeri y’obulamu empya ddala, kubanga tetunnamanya Kristo ng’Omuzabbibu mu bujjuvu bw’amaanyi ge agawa obulamu era agakyusa. Nga twewaayo okulongoosebwa okuva mu byonna eby’okwerowoozaako, n’okwawulibwa ku byonna ebiri mu nsi, tulyoke tubeerewo nga Kristo bwe yabeerawo olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe, ekyo kyokka era n’omutima gwonna. Ate nga tukkiriza nti “nga Nze” kino ddala Kristo ky’ali mwetegefu okutuukiriza, obulamu bwennyini Omuzabbibu bw’anaakuuma mu ttabi eryesigamye ku Ye ddala.

Nga Nze. Buli kiseera bwe kityo, Mukama wange omutendereze: ng’Omuzabbibu bwe guli, n’ettabi bwe liri bwe lityo—obulamu bumu, omwoyo gumu, obuwulize bumu, essanyu limu, okwagala kumu.

Mukama Yesu, mu kukkiriza nti Ggwe Muzabbibu wange, era nti nze ndi ttabi lyo, nkkiriza ekiragiro kyo ng’ekisuubizo, era ntwala “nga Nze” kyo ng’okubikkulirwa okwangu okw’ekyo ky’okola mu nze. Weewaawo, Mukama, nga Ggwe bwe wayagala, nange nnaayagalanga.

Yagala, nga Nze”—bigendereddwa kututuusa ku kutegeera obunafu bwaffe, era okuyita mu ekyo, okutuzuukusa tulabe obwetaavu, n’obulungi, n’obumala bw’ebyo ebituteekeddwateekeddwa mu Muzabbibu. Tujja kutandika okuwulira Omuzabbibu ng’ayogera n’ettabi buli kaseera: “Nga Nze. Nga Nze: Obulamu bwange bwe bulamu bwo; era olina omugabo mu bujjuvu bwange bwonna; Omwoyo ali mu ggwe, n’ekibala ekiva mu ggwe, byonna bye bimu ddala nga bwe biri mu Nze. Totya, naye okukkiriza kwo kukwate buli “Nga Nze” ng’obukakafu obw’obwakatonda nti kubanga mbeera mu ggwe, oyinza era osobola okubeera nga Nze.” Naye lwaki, obanga kino ddala kye kitegeeza ky’olugero, obanga bwe bulamu ddala ettabi bwe liyinza okubeeramu, lwaki batono nnyo ababufuna? Kubanga tebamanyi kyama kya mu ggulu eky’Omuzabbibu. Bamanyi bingi ku lugero n’amasomo gaalwo amalungi. Naye ekyama eky’omwoyo ekikusike eky’Omuzabbibu mu buyinza bwe obw’obwakatonda n’okubeera kwe okumpi, ng’abawanirira era ng’abawa bye beetaaga olunaku lwonna—kino tebakimanyi, kubanga tebalindiridde Mwoyo wa Katonda kukibabikkulira. Mwagalanenga nga nze bwe mbaagala—“Mmwe, nga Nze.” Tunaatandika tutya obanga ddala tugenda kuyiga ekyama kino? Nga twatula nti twetaaga okuleetebwa mu ngeri y’obulamu empya ddala, kubanga tetunnamanya Kristo ng’Omuzabbibu mu bujjuvu bw’amaanyi ge agawa obulamu era agakyusa. Nga twewaayo okulongoosebwa okuva mu byonna eby’okwerowoozaako, n’okwawulibwa ku byonna ebiri mu nsi, tulyoke tubeerewo nga Kristo bwe yabeerawo olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaffe, ekyo kyokka era n’omutima gwonna. Ate nga tukkiriza nti “nga Nze” kino ddala Kristo ky’ali mwetegefu okutuukiriza, obulamu bwennyini Omuzabbibu bw’anaakuuma mu ttabi eryesigamye ku Ye ddala. Nga Nze. Buli kiseera bwe kityo, Mukama wange omutendereze: ng’Omuzabbibu bwe guli, n’ettabi bwe liri bwe lityo—obulamu bumu, omwoyo gumu, obuwulize bumu, essanyu limu, okwagala kumu. Mukama Yesu, mu kukkiriza nti Ggwe Muzabbibu wange, era nti nze ndi ttabi lyo, nkkiriza ekiragiro kyo ng’ekisuubizo, era ntwala “nga Nze” kyo ng’okubikkulirwa okwangu okw’ekyo ky’okola mu nze. Weewaawo, Mukama, nga Ggwe bwe wayagala, nange nnaayagalanga.

fields.title: Omukwano gwa Kristo: Ensibuko Yagwo
fields.body_html:
Tewali kwagala kusinga okw’omuntu awaayo obulamu bwe olwa mikwano gye—Yokaana 15:13

Mu nnyiriri essatu eziddirira, Mukama waffe ayogera ku nkolagana ye n’abayigirizwa be mu ngeri empya—ey’omukwano. Atulaga okwagala omukwano mwe gusibuka ku ludda lwe (olunyiriri 13): obuwulize ku ludda lwaffe obugukuuma (olunyiriri 14); n’oluvannyuma okwesembereza okutukuvu gye gututuusa (olunyiriri 15).

Enkolagana yaffe ne Kristo ya kwagala. Bwe yayogera ku kino emabegako, yatulaga okwagala kwe bwe kwali mu kitiibwa kyakwo eky’omu ggulu; okwagala kwe kumu Kitaffe kwe yamwagalamu. Wano tukulaba nga kweyolese ku nsi—okuwaayo obulamu bwe ku lwaffe. “Tewali kwagala kusinga okw’omuntu awaayo obulamu bwe olwa mikwano gye.” Kristo ddala ayaayaana tumanye nti ekikolo ekikusike n’amaanyi g’ebyo byonna by’ali era by’atukolera ng’Omuzabbibu kwe kwagala. Bwe tuyiga okukkiriza kino, tujja kuwulira nti kino si kintu kye twetaaga okulowoozaako n’okumanya kyokka, wabula maanyi agalamu, bulamu bwa Katonda bwe twetaaga okusembeza munda mu ffe. Kristo n’okwagala kwe tebyawukana; kye kimu. Katonda kwagala, ne Kristo kwagala. Katonda ne Kristo n’okwagala okw’obwakatonda bisobola okumanyibwa nga tubirina byokka, nga obulamu bwabyo n’amaanyi gaabyo bikola munda mu ffe. “Buno bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo, okutegeera ggwe”; tewali kumanya Katonda okutali kwa kuba na bulamu; obulamu obukola mu ffe bwokka bwe buleeta okumanya. Era bwe kityo n’okwagala; bwe tuba twagala okukumanya, tuteekwa okunywa ku mugga gwakwo ogulamu, tuteekwa okukufukibwako Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu ffe.

“Tewali kwagala kusinga okw’omuntu awaayo obulamu bwe olwa mikwano gye.” Obulamu kye kintu ekisinga obuwanana omuntu ky’alina; obulamu bwe byonna by’ali; obulamu ye yennyini. Kino kye kipimo ekisinga obunene eky’okwagala: omuntu bw’awaayo obulamu bwe, taliiko ky’asigaza, awaayo byonna by’alina ne by’ali. Kino Mukama waffe Yesu ky’ayagala okututegeeza ku kyama kye eky’Omuzabbibu: ne byonna by’alina yeetadde mu mikono gyaffe. Ayagala tumutwale nga owaffe ddala; ayagala okubeera owaffe ddala ddala, naffe tulyoke tubeere babe ddala. Yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lwaffe mu kufa, si ng’ekikolwa ekiyita obuyisi, ekyaggwa bwe kyamala okukolebwa; nedda, wabula ng’okwefuula owaffe emirembe gyonna. Obulamu olw’obulamu; yawaayo obulamu bwe tubufune, ffe tulyoke tuwaayo obulamu bwaffe abufune. Kino kye kiyigirizibwa olugero lw’Omuzabbibu n’ettabi, mu kufuuka ekimu kwabyo okw’ekitalo, mu bumu bwabyo obutuukiridde.

Bwe tumanya ekitundu ku kino, si lwa magezi oba kuteebereza, wabula munda ddala mu mutima ne mu bulamu, lwe tunaatandika okulaba obulamu bwaffe bwe bulina okuba ng’amatabi g’Omuzabbibu ogw’omu ggulu. Yeewaayo okufa; yeefiirwa yekka, ffe tulyoke tufune obulamu mu Ye. Ono ye Muzabbibu ogw’amazima, abeerawo olw’okubeera mu ffe kwokka. Eno ye ntandikwa n’ekikolo ky’omukwano omutukuvu Kristo gw’atuyitiramu.

Ekyama ky’okutya Katonda kikulu ddala! Twatule obutamanya bwaffe n’obutakkiriza bwaffe. Tulekere awo okwesigama ku kutegeera kwaffe n’okufuba kwaffe okukitegeera. Tulindirire Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe akitubikkulire. Twesige okwagala kwe okutaliiko kkomo, okwawaayo obulamu bwakwo ku lwaffe, kutwetwalire era kusanyuke mu kutufuula abaakwo ddala.

Obulamu bwe olwa mikwano gye. Amasomo g’Omuzabbibu nga ga kitalo, ogugabira amatabi gaagwo obulamu bwagwo bwennyini! Era Yesu yawaayo obulamu bwe olwa mikwano gye. Era okwagala okwo kwewaayo gye bali ne mu bo. Omuzabbibu wange ogw’omu ggulu, owange, njigiriza nga bw’oyaayaanira okubeera mu nze ddala ddala!

fields.title: Omukwano gwa Kristo: Obujulizi Bwagwo
fields.body_html:
Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira—Yokaana 15:14

Mukama waffe ayogedde kye yawaayo ng’obukakafu bw’omukwano gwe: yawaayo obulamu bwe ku lwaffe. Kaakano atubuulira ekitundu kyaffe kye kiteekwa okuba—okukola ebyo by’atulagira. Yawaayo obulamu bwe okufunira okwagala kwe ekifo mu mitima gyaffe, kutufuge; okwagala kwe kye kutuyita okuddamu, era kye kutuwa amaanyi okukola, kwe kukola by’atulagira. Bwe tumanya okwagala okwafa ku lwaffe, tujja kugondera ebiragiro byakwo n’essanyu. Bwe tugondera ebiragiro, tujja kumanya okwagala okwo mu bujjuvu. Kristo yali amaze okugamba nti: “Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange.” Akiraba nga kyetaagisa okuddamu amazima gano: obukakafu obumu obw’okukkiriza kwaffe mu kwagala kwe, ekkubo erimu ery’okubeera mu kwo, akabonero akamu ak’okuba amatabi ag’amazima, kwe kuno—okukola ebyo by’atulagira. Yatandika n’okwewaayo okujjuvu okw’obulamu bwe ku lwaffe. Tayinza kutusaba kintu kitono okusinga ekyo. Kino kyokka bwe bulamu mu mukwano gwe.

Amazima gano, nti obuwulize bwetaagisa ddala, okukola byonna Kristo by’atulagira, tegalina kifo Kristo kye yali ayagala gabeere nakyo mu kuyigiriza kwaffe n’obulamu bwaffe obw’Ekikristaayo. Enkizo tugiwadde ekifo kya waggulu nnyo okusinga obuvunaanyizibwa. Obuwulize obutaliiko kubuusabuusa tetubutwala ng’obukwakkulizo bw’obuyigirizwa obw’amazima. Ekirowoozo ekikusike nti tekisoboka kukola ebyo by’atulagira, era nti n’olwekyo tekiyinza kusuubirwa okuva gye tuli, n’okuwulira okwekwese okutamanyiddwa nti okwonoona tekwewalika, bitera okunyaga ebiragiro n’ebisuubizo byombi amaanyi gaabyo. Enkolagana yonna ne Kristo ebuutikiddwa ekire era n’ekkakkanyizibwa; okulindirira okuyigiriza kwe, amaanyi ag’okuwulira n’okugondera eddoboozi lye, n’okuyita mu buwulize okunyumirwa okwagala kwe n’omukwano gwe, binafuye olw’ensobi eno ey’entiisa. Ka tugezeeko okuddayo mu kifo eky’amazima, tutwale ebigambo bya Kristo nga bya mazima ddala nga bwe biwandiikiddwa, era tuleme kukkiriza kintu kitono okusinga bino kubeera tteeka ly’obulamu bwaffe: “Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira.” Ddala Mukama waffe tatusaba kitono okusinga okugamba n’omutima gwonna era mu mazima nti: “Weewaawo, Mukama, ky’olagira, kye nnaakola.”

Ebiragiro bino biteekwa okukolebwa ng’obukakafu bw’omukwano. Amaanyi g’okubikola gasinziira ddala ku nkolagana ey’omuntu ku bubwe ne Yesu. Ku lwa mukwano gwange nnyinza okukola kye sandikoledde muntu mulala. Omukwano gwa Yesu gwa mu ggulu era gwa kitalo nnyo, gutujjira ddala ng’amaanyi g’okwagala okw’obwakatonda okuyingira ne kutwetwalira, okussa ekimu naye okutakutuka kwetaagisa nnyo mu gwo, ne kiba nti guleeta era gugaba essanyu n’okwagala ebifuula obuwulize okuba ekinyumu. Eddembe ery’okwetwalira omukwano gwa Yesu, amaanyi ag’okugunyumirwa, ekisa eky’okugukakasa mu mukisa gwagwo gwonna—byonna bijja nga tukola ebyo by’atulagira.

Ekintu ekimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa gye tuli si kwe kusaba Mukama waffe okutweyoleka mu kwagala okw’okufa mwe yakakasiza nti ye mukwano gwaffe, n’oluvannyuma tuwulirize ng’atugamba nti: “Muba mikwano gyange.” Bwe tulaba Mukwano gwaffe ky’atukoledde, era nga mukisa ogutayogerekeka okumuwulira ng’atuyita mikwano gye, okukola ebiragiro bye kujja kufuuka ekibala eky’obutonde eky’obulamu bwaffe mu kwagala kwe. Tetujja kutya kugamba nti: “Weewaawo, Mukama, tuli mikwano gyo, era tukola by’otulagira.”

Bwe mukola. Weewaawo, mu kukola mwe tufunira omukisa, mwe tubeerera mu kwagala kwe, mwe tunyumirwa omukwano gwe. “bwe mukola bye mbalagira!” Ai Mukama wange, omukwano gwo omutukuvu gunnuŋŋamye mu kwagala ebiragiro byo byonna, era okukola ebiragiro byo kunnyingize buli kiseera mu mukwano gwo mu buziba okusingawo.

fields.title: Omukwano gwa Kristo: Okusemberera Kwagwo
fields.body_html:
Olwo nga sikyabayita baddu, kubanga omuddu tamanya bifa ku mukama we. Kaakano mmwe muli mikwano gyange, kubanga mbategeezezza byonna Kitange bye yaŋŋamba—Yokaana 15:15

Obukakafu obusingayo obw’omukwano ogw’amazima, era ensulo ennene ey’essanyu lyagwo, kwe kusemberera okutalina kye kukweka, okukkiriza mukwano gwaffe okugabana naffe ebyama byaffe eby’omunda ennyo. Kya mukisa okuba omuweereza wa Kristo; abo be yanunula basanyuka okweyita abaddu be. Emirundi mingi Kristo yali ayogedde ku bayigirizwa be ng’abaweereza be. fields.title: Okulondebwa
fields.body_html:
Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala—Yokaana 15:16

Ettabi terironda muzabbibu, wadde okusalawo ku muzabbibu ki kwe lirikulira. Omuzabbibu gwe guzaala ettabi, nga bwe gwagala era we gwagala. Bwe kityo ne Kristo agamba nti: “Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda.” Naye abamu baligamba nti: Kino si kye kyawula ettabi ery’omu butonde n’ery’omu mwoyo, nti omuntu alina okwagala n’obusobozi okulonda, era nti olw’okuba yasalawo okukkiriza Kristo, n’amulonda okuba Mukama we, kyava afuuka ettabi? Kino mazima ddala tekiriimu kubuusabuusa. Kyokka kitundu kimu kyokka eky’amazima. Eky’okuyiga eky’Omuzabbibu, n’okuyigiriza kwa Mukama waffe, bisonga ku kitundu ekirala, ekiri wansi ennyo, oludda lwa Katonda olw’okubeera kwaffe mu Kristo. Singa Ye teyatulonda, naffe tetwandimulonze. Okumulonda kwaffe kwava mu kutulonda kwe, n’okutukwata. Mu butonde bw’ebintu, buyinza bwe ng’Omuzabbibu okulonda n’okutonda ettabi lye. Byonna bye tuli tubifuna kubanga tuli mu “abaalondebwamu olw’ekisa.” Bwe tuba twagala okumanya Kristo ng’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, ensibuko yokka n’amaanyi g’obulamu bw’ettabi, era ne twemanya ng’amatabi agamwesigamako ddala, mu ngeri ey’omukisa ennyo era etaliiko kabi, ka tunywe nnyo ku mazima gano ag’omukisa: “Si mmwe mwannonda! Wabula Nze nabalonda.”

Era Kristo kino akyogera lwa nsonga ki? Balyoke bamanye ekigendererwa kye yabalondera, era bafune, mu kukkiriza okulondebwa kwe, obukakafu nti bajja kutuukiriza kye baateekerwawo. Mu Byawandiikibwa byonna kino kye kigendererwa ekikulu eky’okuyigiriza ku kulondebwa. “yabalonda okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi ky’Omwana we.” (okuba amatabi mu kifaananyi n’obufaananyi bw’Omuzabbibu). “Yatulonda okubeera mu Kristo ng’ensi tennatondebwa, ffe tube batukuvu.” “yabalondera obulokozi okuva ku lubereberye, ng’abatukuza olw’okukola kw’Omwoyo.” “be yasooka okumanya ne batukuzibwa Omwoyo olw’okugondere Yesu Kristo.” Abamu bakozesezza bubi enjigiriza y’okulondebwa, n’abalala, olw’okutya okugikozesa obubi, bagigaanye, kubanga baabuusa amaaso okuyigiriza kuno. Beemalidde ku nsibuko yaakwo enkusike mu mirembe n’emirembe, ku byama ebitanoonyezeka eby’okuteesa kwa Katonda, mu kifo ky’okukkiriza okubikkulirwa kw’ekigendererwa kyakwo mu biseera bino, n’emikisa gye kuleeta mu bulamu bwaffe obw’Ekikristaayo.

Kale lowooza emikisa egyo kye giri. Mu lunyiriri lwaffe Kristo abikkula ekigendererwa kye eky’emirundi ebiri mu kutulonda okuba amatabi ge: tulyoke tubale ebibala ku nsi, era tubeere n’amaanyi mu kusaba mu Ggulu. Ng’okulowooza nti yatulondera kino kutuwa obwesige nti talirema kututegeka kutuukiriza kigendererwa kye! Nga bukakafu nti tusobola okubala ebibala eby’olubeerera, era okusaba ne tuweebwa! Nga kino kituyita buli kiseera eri obwetoowaze obusingayo n’okutendereza, eri okwesigama okujjuvu n’okusuubira! Teyanditulonze olw’ekyo kye tutasaanira, oba ky’atasobola kututegekera. Yatulonda; kino gwe musingo nti alikola byonna mu ffe.

Ka tuwulirize, nga emmeeme esirise, Omuzabbibu waffe omutukuvu ng’ayogera na buli omu ku ffe: “Si mmwe mwannonda!” Era ka tugambe nti: “Ye, Mukama, naye nze nakulonda! Amiina, Mukama!” Musabe akulage kino kye kitegeeza. Mu Ye, Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, obulamu bwo ng’ettabi mwe bufunira ensibuko yaabwo eya Katonda, obukuumi bwabwo obw’olubeerera, n’amaanyi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kye. Oyo, gw’obanjibwa byonna olw’okwagala kwe, osobola okumusuubiramu byonna. Mu Ye, mu kigendererwa kye, mu maanyi ge, ne mu bwesigwa bwe, mu kwagala kwe, ka mbeere.

Nze nabalonda. Mukama, njigiriza kino kye kitegeeza—nti omutima gwo ogussizza ku nze, n’onnonda okubala ebibala eby’olubeerera, n’okusaba okusaba okuwangula. Mu kigendererwa kyo kino eky’olubeerera emmeeme yange yandyagadde okuwummula ng’egamba nti: “Ekyo kye yannondera, kye njagala okuba, kye nsobola okuba, era kye ndiba.”

fields.title: Ebibala eby’Olubeerera
fields.body_html:
Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala ate ebibala eby’olubeerera—Yokaana 15:16

Waliwo ebibala ebimu ebitasobola kuterekebwa. Ekika ekimu ekya pea oba eky’apo kirina okuliibwa amangu ddala; ekika ekirala kisobola okuterekebwa okutuusa omwaka ogujja. Bwe kityo ne mu mulimu gw’Ekikristaayo mulimu ebibala ebitawangaala. Wayinza okubaawo ebingi ebisanyusa era ebizimba, kyokka ne watabaawo kabonero ka lubeerera ke kaleka ku maanyi g’ensi oba ku mbeera y’Ekkanisa. Ku luuyi olulala, waliwo omulimu ogulekawo akabonero kaagwo okumala emirembe egiddiriŋŋana oba okutuuka emirembe n’emirembe. Mu gwo amaanyi ga Katonda gawulirwa nga tegaggwaawo. Bye bibala Pawulo by’ayogerako bw’annyonnyola engeri bbiri ez’obuweereza: “Okubuulira kwange n’okuyigiriza tebyali mu bigambo bya magezi ebisendasenda, naye byali mu maanyi ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu; okukkiriza kwammwe kuleme kuba kw’amagezi ga bantu wabula kwesigame ku maanyi ga Katonda.” Omuntu n’amagezi ge n’amaanyi ge gy’akoma okweyongera, obunywevu gye bukoma okukendeera; Omwoyo wa Katonda gy’akoma okweyongera, okukkiriza okwesigama ku maanyi ga Katonda gye kukoma okweyongera.

Ekibala kyolesa obutonde bw’omuti mwe kiva. Kyama ki eky’okubala ebibala eby’olubeerera? Eky’okuddamu kyangu. Obulamu bwaffe bwe bubeera mu Kristo, ffe bwe tubeera mu Ye, n’ebibala bye tubala bwe bibeera eby’olubeerera. Gye tukoma okukkiriza byonna ebiva mu kwagala n’amaanyi g’omuntu okusalibwako n’okulongoosebwa Omulimi ow’omu ggulu, gye tukoma okwekutula ennyo ku by’ebweru, Katonda alyoke akole mu ffe olw’Omwoyo we; kwe kugamba, gye tukoma okubeera mu Kristo ddala, n’ebibala byaffe gye bikoma okubeera eby’olubeerera.

Nga kirowoozo kya mukisa! Yakulonda, n’akuteekawo okubala ebibala, era ebibala byo bibeere eby’olubeerera. Teyagenderera n’akatono ettabi lye lyonna okubala ebibala ebitali bya lubeerera. Gye nkoma okuyingira mu kigendererwa kino eky’ekisa kye ekyannonda, obwesige bwange gye bukoma okunywera nti nsobola okubala ebibala eby’obulamu obutaggwaawo, ku lwange n’abalala. Gye nkoma okuyingira mu kigendererwa kino eky’okwagala kwe okwannonda, gye nkoma okutegeera ekiyunga ekigendererwa ekyava emirembe n’emirembe n’ebibala eby’emirembe n’emirembe: okubeera mu Ye. Ekigendererwa kikye, alikituukiriza; ebibala bibye, alibizaala; okubeera kukwe, alikukuuma.

Buli eyeeyita omukozi w’Ekikristaayo ayimirire akakkanye. Weebuuze obanga olekawo akabonero ak’olubeerera ku abo abakwetoolodde. Si kubuulira kwo oba kuyigiriza kwo, si maanyi ga kwagala kwo oba obusobozi bwo okukyusa abalala, ebinaakituukiriza kino. Byonna byesigama ku kuba n’obulamu bwo obujjudde Katonda n’amaanyi ge. Era ekyo nakyo kyesigama ku kubeera kwo mu bulamu obw’ettabi ddala obw’okubeera mu Kristo—okussa ekimu ne Kristo okw’okumpi ennyo okutakutuka. Lye ttabi, eribeera mu Ye, eribala ebibala bingi, ebibala eby’olubeerera.

Mukama Omutendereze, nkwegayiridde, bikkulira emmeeme yange nti wannonda okubala ebibala bingi. Kino kibeere obwesige bwange, nti ekigendererwa kyo kiyinza okutuukirira—ggwe wannonda. Kino kibeere amaanyi gange okuleka byonna ne nneewaayo gy’oli. Ggwe kennyini olituukiriza ekyo kye watandika. Nsikiriza nnyo okubeera mu kwagala n’obukakafu obw’ekigendererwa ekyo eky’olubeerera, amaanyi ag’emirembe n’emirembe gantwale, n’ebibala bye mbala bibeere eby’olubeerera.

Mulyoke mubale ebibala. Ayi Omuzabbibu wange ow’omu ggulu, kitandise okutangaalira emmeeme yange nti ebibala, ebibala ebisingawo—ebibala bingi—ebibala eby’olubeerera kye kintu kimu ky’olina okumpa, era kye kintu kimu nze ng’ettabi kye nnina okukuwa! Nze wuuno. Mukama Omutendereze, tuukiriza ekigendererwa kyo mu nze; ka mbale ebibala bingi, ebibala eby’olubeerera, olw’ekitiibwa kyo.

Ekika ekimu ekya pea oba eky’apo kirina okuliibwa amangu ddala; ekika ekirala kisobola okuterekebwa okutuusa omwaka ogujja. Bwe kityo ne mu mulimu gw’Ekikristaayo mulimu ebibala ebitawangaala. Ku luuyi olulala, waliwo omulimu ogulekawo akabonero kaagwo okumala emirembe egiddiriŋŋana oba okutuuka emirembe n’emirembe. Mu gwo amaanyi ga Katonda gawulirwa nga tegaggwaawo. Bye bibala Pawulo by’ayogerako bw’annyonnyola engeri bbiri ez’obuweereza: “Okubuulira kwange n’okuyigiriza tebyali mu bigambo bya magezi ebisendasenda, naye byali mu maanyi ne Mwoyo Mutukuvu; okukkiriza kwammwe kuleme kuba kw’amagezi ga bantu wabula kwesigame ku maanyi ga Katonda.” Omuntu n’amagezi ge n’amaanyi ge gy’akoma okweyongera, obunywevu gye bukoma okukendeera; Omwoyo wa Katonda gy’akoma okweyongera, okukkiriza okwesigama ku maanyi ga Katonda gye kukoma okweyongera. Ekibala kyolesa obutonde bw’omuti mwe kiva. Kyama ki eky’okubala ebibala eby’olubeerera? Eky’okuddamu kyangu. Obulamu bwaffe bwe bubeera mu Kristo, ffe bwe tubeera mu Ye, n’ebibala bye tubala bwe bibeera eby’olubeerera. Gye tukoma okukkiriza byonna ebiva mu kwagala n’amaanyi g’omuntu okusalibwako n’okulongoosebwa Omulimi ow’omu ggulu, gye tukoma okwekutula ennyo ku by’ebweru, Katonda alyoke akole mu ffe olw’Omwoyo we; kwe kugamba, gye tukoma okubeera mu Kristo ddala, n’ebibala byaffe gye bikoma okubeera eby’olubeerera. Nga kirowoozo kya mukisa! Yakulonda, n’akuteekawo okubala ebibala, era ebibala byo bibeere eby’olubeerera. Teyagenderera n’akatono ettabi lye lyonna okubala ebibala ebitali bya lubeerera. Gye nkoma okuyingira mu kigendererwa kino eky’ekisa kye ekyannonda, obwesige bwange gye bukoma okunywera nti nsobola okubala ebibala eby’obulamu obutaggwaawo, ku lwange n’abalala. Gye nkoma okuyingira mu kigendererwa kino eky’okwagala kwe okwannonda, gye nkoma okutegeera ekiyunga ekigendererwa ekyava emirembe n’emirembe n’ebibala eby’emirembe n’emirembe: okubeera mu Ye. Ekigendererwa kikye, alikituukiriza; ebibala bibye, alibizaala; okubeera kukwe, alikukuuma. Buli eyeeyita omukozi w’Ekikristaayo ayimirire akakkanye. Weebuuze obanga olekawo akabonero ak’olubeerera ku abo abakwetoolodde. Si kubuulira kwo oba kuyigiriza kwo, si maanyi ga kwagala kwo oba obusobozi bwo okukyusa abalala, ebinaakituukiriza kino. Byonna byesigama ku kuba n’obulamu bwo obujjudde Katonda n’amaanyi ge. Era ekyo nakyo kyesigama ku kubeera kwo mu bulamu obw’ettabi ddala obw’okubeera mu Kristo—okussa ekimu ne Kristo okw’okumpi ennyo okutakutuka. Lye ttabi, eribeera mu Ye, eribala ebibala bingi, ebibala eby’olubeerera. Mukama Omutendereze, nkwegayiridde, bikkulira emmeeme yange nti wannonda okubala ebibala bingi. Kino kibeere obwesige bwange, nti ekigendererwa kyo kiyinza okutuukirira—ggwe wannonda. Kino kibeere amaanyi gange okuleka byonna ne nneewaayo gy’oli. Ggwe kennyini olituukiriza ekyo kye watandika. Nsikiriza nnyo okubeera mu kwagala n’obukakafu obw’ekigendererwa ekyo eky’olubeerera, amaanyi ag’emirembe n’emirembe gantwale, n’ebibala bye mbala bibeere eby’olubeerera. Mulyoke mubale ebibala. Ayi Omuzabbibu wange ow’omu ggulu, kitandise okutangaalira emmeeme yange nti ebibala, ebibala ebisingawo—ebibala bingi—ebibala eby’olubeerera kye kintu kimu ky’olina okumpa, era kye kintu kimu nze ng’ettabi kye nnina okukuwa! Nze wuuno. Mukama Omutendereze, tuukiriza ekigendererwa kyo mu nze; ka mbale ebibala bingi, ebibala eby’olubeerera, olw’ekitiibwa kyo.

fields.title: Okusaba Okuwangula
fields.body_html:
Mulyoke mubale ebibala ate ebibala eby’olubeerera. Olwo buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga—Yokaana 15:16

Mu lunyiriri olusooka olw’olugero lwaffe, Kristo yeebikkula ng’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, ne Kitaffe ng’Omulimi, n’asaba ekifo mu mutima ku lulwe ne ku lwa Kitaffe. Wano, mu lunyiriri olusembayo, afunza okuyigiriza kwe kwonna ku Ye yennyini ne ku Kitaffe mu kigendererwa eky’emirundi ebiri kye yabalondera. Ku lulwe, Omuzabbibu, ekigendererwa kyali nti babale ebibala. Ku lwa Kitaffe, kyali nti buli kye banaasabanga mu linnya lye, Kitaffe ali mu Ggulu akibakolere. Ng’ebibala bwe biri obukakafu obukulu obw’enkolagana entuufu ne Kristo, n’okusaba bwe kutyo bwe kuli obukakafu obw’enkolagana yaffe ne Kitaffe. Okubeera mu Mwana nga tubala ebibala, n’okusaba Kitaffe okuwangula, bye bintu ebibiri ebikulu mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obw’amazima.

Buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.—Bino bye bigambo ebisembayo eby’olugero lw’Omuzabbibu. Ekyama kyonna eky’Omuzabbibu n’amatabi gaagwo kituusa ku kyama ekirala—nti buli kye tusaba mu linnya lye, Kitaffe akituwa! Laba wano ensonga lwaki tetusaba kimala, era lwaki okusaba kwaffe tekuliimu maanyi. Kiri bwe kityo kubanga tetulina nnyo bulamu obw’ettabi obw’amazima, kubanga tetwebuza nnyo mu Muzabbibu, nga tubeera mu Ye ddala, kyetuva tuwulira nga tetukakiddwa kusaba nnyo, nga tetwekakasa nti tujja kuwulirwa, era bwe tutyo ne tutamanya kukozesa linnya lye ng’ekisumuluzo ky’amawanika ga Katonda. Omuzabbibu ogwasimbibwa ku nsi gutuuse mu Ggulu; emmeeme yokka ebeera mu gwo ddala era n’amaanyi, y’esobola okutuuka mu Ggulu n’amaanyi okuwangula ennyo. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu kuyigiriza n’amazima g’olugero, mu mazima n’obulamu bw’Omuzabbibu, kulina okweyoleka mu maanyi g’okusaba. Obulamu obw’okubeera mu Kristo n’obuwulize, obw’okwagala n’essanyu, obw’okulongoosebwa n’okubala ebibala, ddala bulituusa ku maanyi g’okusaba okuwangula.

Buli kye munaasabanga—Ekisuubizo kyaweebwa abayigirizwa abaali beetegese okwewaayo, mu kifaananyi ky’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, ku lw’abantu bannaabwe. Ekisuubizo kino kye kyali entanda yaabwe yonna ey’omulimu gwabwe; baakitwala nga bwe kiri, baakikkiriza, baakikozesa, era ne bakisanga nga kya mazima. Ka twewaayo, ng’amatabi g’Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima, era mu kifaananyi kye, eri omulimu gw’okulokola abantu, ogw’okubala ebibala olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, era tujja kufuna okukubirizibwa okuggya n’amaanyi okusaba n’okubanja “buli kye munaasabanga.” Tujja kuzuukuka tutegeere obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe obw’ekitalo obw’okuba nti mu kisuubizo ng’ekyo twaweebwa ebisumuluzo by’amawanika ga Kabaka, era tetujja kuwummula okutuusa nga tufunye emmere n’omukisa ku lw’abo ababula.

“Nze nabalonda, mulyoke mubale ebibala ate ebibala eby’olubeerera. Olwo buli kye munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange anaakibawanga.” Omuyigirizwa omwagalwa, noonya okusinga byonna okuba omuntu w’okusaba. Wano we wali okukozesa okusingayo okw’enkizo yo ng’ettabi ly’Omuzabbibu; wano we wali obukakafu obujjuvu nti wazzibwa buggya mu kifaananyi kya Katonda n’Omwana we; wano we wali amaanyi go okulaga nti, nga Kristo, tobeerawo ku lulwo wekka, wabula ku lw’abalala; wano w’oyingirira mu Ggulu okufuna ebirabo ku lw’abantu; wano okubeera kwo mu Kristo kutuusizza ku kubeera kwe mu ggwe, akukozese ng’omukutu era ekikozesebwa eky’ekisa kye. Amaanyi g’okubala ebibala ku lw’abantu gatikkiddwa engule ey’amaanyi g’okuwangula ne Katonda.

“Nze muzabbibu ogw’amazima, ate Kitange ye mulimi.” Omulimu gwa Kristo mu ggwe kwe kukuleeta eri Kitaffe bw’atyo, Ekigambo kye kituukirire mu ggwe: “Mu kiseera ekyo mulisaba mu linnya lyange, so si Nze okubasabira eri Kitange. Kitange abaagala nnyo.” Amaanyi ag’okutuuka butereevu eri Kitaffe ku lw’abantu, eddembe ery’okwegayiririra abalala nga tubanja era nga tufuna omukisa ku lwabwe mu kukkiriza, kwe kukozesa okusingayo okw’obumu bwaffe ne Kristo. Bonna abaagala okuba amatabi mu mazima era mu bujjuvu beewaayo eri omulimu gw’okwegayiririra abalala. Gwe mulimu gumu omunene ogwa Kristo Omuzabbibu mu Ggulu, ensibuko y’amaanyi g’omulimu gwe gwonna. Gufuule omulimu gwo gumu omunene ng’ettabi: gulibeera amaanyi g’omulimu gwo gwonna.

Mu linnya lyange. Weewaawo, Mukama, mu linnya lyo, erinnya eriggya lye weetuuma wano, Omuzabbibu ogw’amazima. Ng’ettabi, nga mbeera mu ggwe mu kwewaayo kwonna, mu kwesigama okujjuvu, mu kufaanana ggwe okutuukiridde, mu kubala ebibala okw’olubeerera, nzija eri Kitaffe, mu ggwe, era alimpa kye nsaba. Ayi, obulamu bwange bubeere obw’okwegayiririra abalala okutalekera awo era okuwangula! Amiina!
